114001.description: Hanami Harumaki is a high school P.E. teacher with daily morning entrance duty at the school's gate. Tomboyish and awkward, she meets a new student, Urara Momojima, who surprisingly, has natural and striking pink hair (pink haired girls have a reputation for lewdness in dating sim games). Momojima immediately takes a liking to Ms. Harumaki, and makes her best to seduce her, but they're both not particularly "smart" girls. Watch them as they stupidly stumble their way to love!!!

114002.description:
I will accept this twisted love…For my hometown and their happiness…

(Source: fakku)

114003.description:
Maki's first love was her high school classmate, a girl named Midori. But Midori broke up with Maki at graduation, saying they were now "too old to be fooling around dating girls." Ten years later, Maki still can’t get Midori off her mind, and when the two women reconnect after a chance encounter, Maki realizes that, while her feelings haven’t changed, Midori has long moved on—in fact, she's engaged. Yet the more Maki hears Midori talk about her soon-to-be-husband, the more red flags she notices. And Midori has another secret, one she hasn’t yet shared with Maki. Will it be the last blow to Maki's hopes that their romance might be rekindled? Or will it be the push that sets them on a new path—one they'll travel together?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

114004.description: A mermaid encounters a suicidal man standing on the edge of a cliff.

114005.description:
You can fall in love countless times, but your first love is special. "In elementary school, there's no such thing as love!"

Koharuko is a 6th grader with a blunt personality. She is popular with girls, but often gets bullied by boys. Annoyed by the boys' childishness, she can't even imagine liking one. But, Ichijo from her class is a boy so mature, you would hardly believe he is just an elementary school student... She falls in love, and every new day is dazzling.

A realistic elementary school love story for a new generation!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)
synonyms: My first love like a bright sun.

title.english: My First Love Like a Bright Sun

114006.description:
After losing her mother and her own life, Jiuqing gets a chance to make things right! Now she’ll stop at nothing to uncover the truth and to save her beloved mother. No longer playing the part of the dutiful daughter blindly following orders or the mild girl preparing to be an obedient wife, she’s learning medicine, the healing arts, and what it means to fall in love. As she discovers more in a few months than she had in her last lifetime, where will this newfound fire within her lead to?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

114008.description:
I found real happiness ≪here≫ in the demon lord's army.

Cromwell, who held his abilities back while hiding in his flawless best friends' shadow, was one day taken to the demon lord's army. Getting "serious" he does things like, reforming the demon lord's army while living together comfortably with his succubus secretary and a little demon girl.

title.native: 陰に隠れてた俺が魔王軍に入って本当の幸せを掴むまで
title.romaji: Kage ni Kakureteta Ore ga Maougun ni Haitte Hontou no Shiawase wo Tsukamu made

title.native: 丹羽くんはただの友達です！
title.romaji: Niwa-kun wa Tada no Tomodachi desu!

114010.description:
What's a maid to do when she finds herself suddenly stuck in Japan for a year? Eat, of course! Follow maid-in-training Suzume Tachibana as she tries all sorts of Japanese food, from sweets like taiyaki and melon bread to savory snacks like takoyaki and onigiri! Be warned, though—while Suzume sates her appetite through delicious treat after delicious treat, she might just end up whetting yours!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Miss Maid Simply Loves to Eat
Maid Just Simply Love to Eat

title.english: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
title.native: メイドさんは食べるだけ

114011.description:
Being unable to wake up from a dream feels so good…

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #35

114012.description:
My relationship with my girlfriend has been terribly soiled.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #32

114013.description:
The pure flower bud's ephemeral blossoming...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #40

114014.description:
Earnest maiden falling prey to sinister ways...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #48

114015.description:
My childhood friend Shida Kuroha seems to have feelings for me. She lives next door, and is small and cute. With an outgoing character, she’s the caring Onee-san type, this being one of her greatest strengths.

…But, I already have my first love, the beautiful idol of our school, and the award-winning author high school girl, Kachi Shirokusa! Thinking about it rationally, I should have no chances with her, but, while walking home from school, she only talks to me, with a smile even! I might actually have a chance, don’t you think?!

Or so I thought, but then I heard that Shirokusa already has a boyfriend, and my life took a turn for the worse. I want to die. Why is it not me?! Even though she was my first love…As I was drowning in despair and depression, Kuroha whispered.

—If it’s that tough for you, then how about we get revenge? The best revenge ever, that is~
synonyms: Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Makenai Love Comedy
The Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose!

title.native: 幼なじみが絶対に負けないラブコメ
title.romaji: Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Makenai Love Kome

114016.description: The manga is an anthology story centering on the Crypters, the betrayer agents of Chaldea that are the center of the Fate/Grand Order smartphone game's "Lostbelt" story line.

title.native: Fate/Grand Order フロム ロストベルト

114017.description:
A quiet and demure look at what happened before GRAND ORDER!

Romani Archaman, better known as Dr. Roman, heads the Chaldea Security Organization and as the group's chief medical officer he is tasked to watch over a young lady named Mash Kyrielight. His approach is a much more gentler and thoughtful one, full of books and relationships. Much like that relationship, this scrapbook is a collection of tales from the world of Fate/Grand Order as it has never been seen before.

(Source: DENPA)
synonyms: 페이트/그랜드 오더 칼데아 스크랩 : 나카타니 작품집

114018.description:
Winner of the 2018 (21st) Japan Media Arts New Face Award.

Included one-shots:
Toumei Ningen
IDOL
Hebi Ichigo

114019.description: This is the Waai! serialization of Himegoto, the first one in the franchise.

title.native: フットボール アルケミスト

114021.description: This is the Febri serialization of Himegoto.

114022.description:
The Pits of Hell offers nine stories that established Ebisu as one of the leading figures of the ugly-but-amazing ‘heta-uma’ movement, the Japanese equivalent of punk and new wave.

(Source: Breakdown Press)

title.native: 地獄に堕ちた教師ども

114024.description:
After the plain me moved in together with the popular Azuma-kun, my whole world changed. But even then, we’re still people of different Worlds. Being born on Earth as a ‘normal human being’ – that’s me.

I’ve came to realise the difference in our social standing. To the handsome and popular Azuma-kun, my existence is but a far and tiny thing. I’m sure it can’t even be seen. That’s why… Before these feelings turn into Love, I wanted so much to pull myself away---

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Powapowa Kurun♥".
- Includes the one-shot "Kotori no Tomarigi".

114025.description:
Hana Natori is an earnest, good-natured 25-year-old woman whose cousin refuses to go to high school. Hana takes her cousin's place and attends the high school. On her first day, though, Hana's ruse is discovered by her former high school classmate Okito Kanie — who happens to be the high school's world history teacher.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: 25歲的女高中生～讓老師來教教妳什麼叫做兒童不宜觀賞

title.english: 25-Year-Old High School Girl, I Wouldn't Do This with a Kid
title.native: 25歳の女子高生～子供には教えられないことシてやるよ
title.romaji: 25-Sai no Joshikousei: Kodomo ni wa Oshierarenai Koto Shite Yaru yo

114027.description:
Taiga dreams of becoming an actor, so the first thing he does upon entering high school is join the drama club. There, he meets the beautiful, enigmatic Maria and immediately falls in love with her. Not long after, Taiga is told that she is actually a boy—but is that all there is to Maria's story? This beautifully illustrated, single-volume tale explores the nature of personal expression and the fluidity of the power of love.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114029.description: Yuzu is an unlucky girl who caught a cold on the day of her high school entrance ceremony. When she finally returns to school, her best friend Saori tells her that she has the school's biggest delinquent, Ren Shidou, in her class. Yuzu, who is ordinary and longs for a normal high school life, dismisses the story as nothing to do with her, but she runs into Ren, who is injured under a cherry tree. Yuzu is frightened, but still treats his wounds, then, Ren forcibly calls for her after school...?

title.native: 溺愛ヤンキーに目をつけられました

114031.description: Story about ghost girl and pervy boi.
synonyms: 足があるタイプの幽霊

114032.description:
A girl adopts a parakeet, which eventually grows bigger than a human.

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

title.native: 放課後のキス、私たちの秘密
title.romaji: Houkago no Kiss, Watashitachi no Himitsu

114034.description:
Miyu, a second year at high school, is in love with “love,” and has the hobby of observing the school’s hottest guys during break time, her enthusiasm for it never failing to amaze her friends, Ayuto and Eri. But when Eri asks Miyu why she won’t pick the handsome and cool-looking Ayuto, whom she has an inseparable relationship with after finding out they were fans of the same band, Miyu replies that Ayuto is just a friend. In contrast to Miyu’s lack of interest, however, is Ayuto, who has a crush on her that everyone but her can see!

Suddenly, Miyu ends up exchanging contact details with the cool and popular Imai-senpai at Ayuto’s part-time job, leaving her in high spirits! Meanwhile, Ayuto, who knows about Imai-senpai’s womanizing tendencies, is worried…

It’s a sugary romance comedy between these two!!!
114034.hashtag: 溺愛なんてズルすぎる

title.native: 溺愛なんてズルすぎる!!

114035.description:
"Your lips are so sweet... I feel like I'm going to melt just from a kiss." Michi is a beautiful receptionist who cheerfully does her best at her job. She seems perfect, but actually she loves eating—a ton ! Because of that, none of her relationships have gone well, and she's afraid to confess her feelings to Taichi, the heir to one of her company's clients. One day, Taichi sees her eating a snack in secret on her break. It makes him set his sights on her! It's a Cinderella story for a receptionist who's afraid of romance.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

114036.description:
The Hero’s party was attacked by a large group of powerful devils. The party will no doubt be annihilated if this were to go on.
One member of the party, the strongest mage, Rakku, decided to stop the enemies in their tracks.
"Leave it to me here and go!"
"But……"
"Hey, I’ll catch up immediately, alright?"
Rakku mindlessly defeated the enemies, over and over again.
Using his special skill, Learning, Rakku learned the devils’ magic.
As he studied and utilised the devils’ abilities such as Drain Touch, he continued fighting, without rest nor sleep.
The devils got stronger and stronger, but Rakku too rapidly grew.
Rakku battled for 10 years, until no devils came at him.
Rakku returned to the capital, and was surprised.
His own name became the currency, and a gigantic statue of him, albeit fairly beautified, was made.
Due to him relentlessly absorbing the vitality of the devils, he had become young again.
An appearance unfitting of his age. Godly abilities.
"I stand out too much."
Rakku concealed his true identity, and decided to pretend being a novice adventurer.
Rakku, disguising as a F-rank warrior despite being an S-rank mage. His adventure in this now peaceful (?) world starts now!
synonyms: 10 Years After Saying "Leave This to Me and Go," I Became a Legend
I Became a Legend a Decade Later After Telling my Comrades to Leave Everything to Me and Retreat First
說出這邊交給我你們先走以後十年過去成了傳說。
I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand

title.native: ここは俺に任せて先に行けと言ってから10年がたったら伝説になっていた。
title.romaji: Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Itte kara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita.

114037.description: Due to a certain circumstances, Minato Aya refused to involve herself with others. Her world becomes stagnant until an encounter with certain boy who loves painting, Oosaki Minoru, her world slowly starts to move again.

title.romaji: Itsuka, Tanshoku no Sora no Shita

114038.description:
University student Naruse appears as a customer before Kei, a travel host from an Erogenous Aesthetic shop specializing in services to women. Kei offers Naruse the limited edition "Return to Origins Course", after being asked to treat Naruse as he would a girl.

He can't provide an honest service to Naruse after being tricked, after all. But Naruse, who chose the service, experiences a profoundly sad memory amidst this encounter...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114045.description: The manga focuses on Fujimura and Mash trying out real recipes and dishes from across history.
synonyms: Fate/Grand Order: The Heroic Spirit Food Chronicles

114046.description:
Looking for good men all over the world, Queen Medb continues her quest!

Featuring:
- College Student Medb-chan
- OL Medb-chan
- Ulster pickup
- Let's rebuild!
- Bonding lesson
- Oda meeting in the Chaldea world
- Am I a cat?
- Queen Medb-chan

This is an anthology collection from Aono Shimo featuring comics centered on Medb, a character first featured in Fate/Grand Order, Fifth Singularity: E Pluribus Unum.
synonyms: Fate/Grand Order Medb!Medb!Medb Aono Shimo Works
페이트/그랜드 오더 메이브 메이브 메이브! : 아오노 시모 작품집

title.native: Fate/Grand Order　メイヴ・メイヴ・メイヴ！　青乃下作品集
title.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: Medb!Medb!Medb! - Aono Shimo Sakuhinshuu

114047.description: An anthology collection featuring Jeanne d'Arc and Jeanne d'Arc Alter amid events centered around the Luluhawa Servant Festival.

title.native: Fate/Grand Order TAZU-CINEMA 過たず作品集

114048.description:
“Off to a late start?” Yeah, well who says you can only begin your adventure when you’re young?
“The early bird catches the worm.” Or so they say. Yet our hero, Rick Gladiator, passed his 30th birthday before taking even his first step as an adventurer.
He may just be getting started, but he’s already showing S-Rank level powers. His teachers, the legendary party Orichalcum Fist, are monstrously strong (literally—check out the dragon and vampire), and they’ve put him through a training regimen from hell. Now, Rick faces down the elite adventurers who scoff at him, prepared to teach them a lesson about respecting their elders—and they may just have to learn it the hard way.

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
The Middle-Aged Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Strongest Party, Became Unbeatable
Aquel aventurero treintañero que se entrenó hasta la muerte con los más fuertes hasta volverse invencible

title.english: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
title.native: 新米オッサン冒険者、最強パーティに死ぬほど鍛えられて無敵になる。
title.romaji: Shinmai Ossan Bouken-sha, Saikyou Party ni Shinu Hodo Kitaerarete Muteki ni Naru.

114049.description: After Yul is suddenly informed of her break up, she decides to become an SNS celebrity in order to show her success to her ex-boyfriend.

114050.description:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Magical★Explorer - It Seems I Have Become a Friend of the Protagonist in an Eroge World, but Because Magic Is Fun I Have Abandoned the Role and Train Myself
Reincarnated as a Eroge Hero's Friend, I'll Live Freely with My Eroge Knowledge
แมจิคัล☆เอกซ์พลอเรอร์ เซียนเกมตัวฉกาจจุติมาผงาดในเกมจีบสาว
Magical★Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim

title.native: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる
title.romaji: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru

114053.description:
Kei's older brother just recently passed away, leaving Kei with a large inheritance. When his mother relinquishes his brother's tablet to him, Kei is surprised to find pictures of his brother and his friend and former schoolmate, Akinari being intimate with each other ー in a relationship. Kei reminiscences his memories of the two: his admiration for both his brother and Akinari, in two different contexts. Kei decides to visit Akinari to confront him. Reunited, Kei realizes that his feelings for Akinari are more than just childish admiration. But Kei also realizes that his brother's ghost will always continue to linger in everything around him.

(Source: Futekiya)

114054.description: With tensions between the neighboring country rising signaling the presence of a war soon to begin, Soalla, the princess of a small country, worried whether her own country would be able to defend itself with its weak national power. The king was bedridden and the retainers who were her last rays of hope had nothing but the antiquated motto of battle honor in mind. Not one person had a concrete proposal to protect the country, leaving Soalla to wonder if this was where Favell would fall... However, it was then that Naoki appeared before her. A "magician," that left his name in history who possessed the power she desired to save the country.
synonyms: Survival Strategy Thinking with Game Theory for Save the Weak

title.native: 数字で救う! 弱小国家

synonyms: Yuzu-Chan Has a Lot of Hedgehogs

title.native: ゆづちゃんはハリネズミがささってる

114057.description:
A high school student with millions of in-game earnings, Kaname Suou is one of the strongest Dealers in Money (Game) Master, a virtual world where nothing is against the rules. Assisted by his succubus AI partner, Tselika, he seeks the Overtrick-a set of powerful cheat-level weapons that break the laws of physics-and one young girl. What does it take to save somebody in a VR city with gunfights, car chases, and high-stakes stock market gambling? What exactly is in the cards for Kaname and his associates?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: マギステルス・バッドトリップ

114058.description:
Sousuke is an attractive man from a good family and there’s no shortage of women willing to date him. Upon rescuing his grandfather’s jellyfish from a trip to the landfill, he finds a beautiful, mysterious, air-headed boy before him! What lessons in love could Sousuke possibly learn from a jellyfish?!

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: ไม่มีทางที่ผมจะหลงรักแมงกะพรุน

title.native: 月夜のクラゲは恋に泣く
title.romaji: Tsukiyo no Kurage wa Koi ni Naku

114059.description: The story of a singer with cold hands and a warm heart and a considerate artist.

114061.description: A lonely girl named Nanami loses her only companionship, her beloved cat. To try and move on from this terrible phase in her life, she tries to go to a resort to relax, but its not working at all, with the pain of loss still very much alive inside of her. Until, she meets a woman that greatly reminds her of what she once lost.

title.native: センチメンタル ビーチサイド

114062.description:
In a world torn apart by an apocalypse, two lonely little girls chance upon a strange video. To their surprise and joy, a girl with long black hair named Sadako climbs out of the TV... But little do they know that Sadako is a vengeful ghost who will kill them in a week! In order to help their new friend, these two sweet, innocent girls begin a journey to the end of the world to look for more victims friends. Can their bond with Sadako help her find peace and finally break the curse? Or will this tale have a tragic ending...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Sadako at the End of the World

114063.description:
Ambitious Saori Fujiya may be pushing 30 by now, but romance is absolutely the least of her problems – she’s committed to her job, and she’s really good at it! So it’s nothing but an unwelcome distraction when every time she makes her rounds at Touma General Hospital, a certain Doctor Maki keeps attempting to reel her in with his flirty charms...

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: The doctor prescribes love to me.

title.native: 強引ドクターの溺愛処方箋

114066.description: Risa, 27, who works for an advertising agency, doesn't care about romance and pursues her dream of working. One day, she is carrying her luggage and is about to fall down when someone suddenly lends her a hand. It belongs to Maruyama, who works for the same company. Although he is silent, inexpressive and hostile (the really handsome type), Risa is overwhelmed by the kindness she sees in him. What she doesn't understand is that when Risa works several hours overtime, Maruyama is always there for some reason...
synonyms: Mukuchi na Kare ga Zangyou suru Riyuu

title.english: The Reason Why the Quiet Man Works Overtime
title.native: 無口な彼が残業する理由
title.romaji: Mukuchi na Kare ga Zangyousuru Riyuu

114067.description: Matsubayashi wants to be friends with his prim and proper classmate, Miyazen. And unbeknownst to him, the feeling is mutual. However, being a brash-looking delinquent, he has a lot of trouble communicating with her, despite her valiant (and embarrassing) attempts to use references to his favourite media.
synonyms: お近づきになりたい漫画

title.native: お近づきになりたい宮膳さん

114068.description:
Nineteen-year-old Ruri Morikawa gets wrangled into a messy situation when her selfish childhood friend strands her in another world! To make matters somehow worse, a mysterious conspiracy then gets her abandoned in a perilous forest. Through an unexpected turn of events, she comes into possession of a mystical bracelet that allows her to transform into a white cat. Now that she's in the Land of the Dragon King, she has to hide the fact that she's human—which means spending her days as a little white cat, for the time being... But how will she exact her much-earned revenge against those who’ve wronged her while stuck in the form of a small, fluffy, cuddly kitty cat?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: A Vengeful White Cat Lounges Around on the Dragon King's Lap
แมวขาวสาบานจะแก้แค้นแต่มัววางแผนบนตักราชามังกร

title.english: The White Cat's Revenge as Plotted from the Dragon King's Lap
title.native: 復讐を誓った白猫は竜王の膝の上で惰眠をむさぼる
title.romaji: Fukushuu wo Chikatta Shironeko wa Ryuuou no Hiza no Ue de Damin wo Musaboru

title.native: 八男って、それはないでしょう！ ～はじまりの物語～
title.romaji: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!: Hajimari no Monogatari

114070.description:
Kiko came to study abroad in Harajuku and ended living in a share-house, the boy who came to greet her at the station is untalkative and fierce looking.

Is he kind? Is he cold? Why did he call me 'cute'?

The romance with a mysterious manーー
Is having grim prospects!

114071.description: Ai Natsuha is the granddaughter of Gokusetsu Gumi, the most powerful organization in Japan. Her current life has changed completely, as the current general of the Tsukijo Gumi has announced that the man who became Ai's husband will be the next general of the Tsukijo Gumi.

title.native: 狼さんと死にぞこない

114075.description:
Karasuma-kun, who had been in a fight, fell in love with the owner of the butler cafe, which is full of masculinity! He asked her to work part-time at her shop every day. It's a Yankee, but it's very popular with young ladies for his clumsy efforts !
Junjo Yankee's constant love is...!?

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)
synonyms: Young Lady, I'm a Yankee Butler

title.native: お嬢さま、ヤンキー執事でございます

114076.description:
Office worker Azusa was supposed to be an administrative worker, but for reasons unbeknownst to her, she got hand-picked to be the personal secretary to the CEO of a major company! The CEO, Shindo, is a young, handsome genius, but his demeanor is cold and unwelcoming. He's such a tyrant that a previous secretary quit only 2 hours after starting the job! However, one day, after her coworkers invite Azusa to a mixer, Shindo makes a declaration: "If you're looking for a lover, then let it be me." An office romance between the cold CEO and his worrywart secretary, who he is madly in love with.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

114077.description:
Cruz was reincarnated as a low-class demon into Makai, the underworld. In her past life, she aimed to become a top pâtissière, so now she’s bewildered by the dank food of this world! However, she is touched by the kindness of the demons around her. She declares, “I will make the citizens of Makai happy with sweets!” Cruz starts by creating the underworld's very first “parfait” with limited materials. When the demons taste her desserts, they're instantly captivated! Eventually, even the powerful Demon Lord hears the rumors of her exploits and summons Cruz to attend him…?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I was Pleased to Make a Parfait for the Demon King
Mr. Devil Rejoiced When I Made Parfait

title.native: 魔王様にパフェを作ったら喜ばれました
title.romaji: Maou-sama ni Parfait wo Tsukuttara Yorokobaremashita

114078.description:
In the future, robots are more than machines. Autonomous “cyber-persons” with A.I. brains are part of society, interacting with humans and growing their own culture. In fact, they may be surpassing humans, as biological homo sapiens and their own world have begun to die out. But are humans truly disappearing, or are robots the new “humans”?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes: Nominated to the 24th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.
synonyms: A Brief History of Robo Sapiens
Une brève histoire du ROBO SAPIENS

title.native: ロボ・サピエンス前史

synonyms: フェアリー・ファーマシー
フェアリー・ファーマシー

114081.description:
Michela is a 13-year-old student at the Clausura Academy of Magic and Sorcery, a school for magic-holders aspiring to become “Wizards.” Unfortunately, she lacks even the most basic control over her powers, with all her attempts at spell-casting inadvertently ending up in explosions.

One day, Michela sets off a particularly nasty explosion that stood to consume anything and everything around her. Just when death seemed imminent—

A young man appears before Michela, deflecting the blast in the nick of time. Introducing himself as Eusius, the young man tells of a foreboding tale: that he has come from the future to save her... and that she’s fated to die at the young age of 18...

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

title.native: 落命魔女と時をかける旦那様の死なない婚約印
title.romaji: Rakumei Majo to Toki wo Kakeru Danma-sama no Shinanai Konyakuin

114083.description: Ena meets Oswald, a legendary magician who was said to have died 10 years ago. He tasks her with undoing the curse that has caused him to remain in a childlike form.

title.native: エナとオズの魔法事情
title.romaji: Ena to Oz no Mahou Jijou

synonyms: I Like You. But Sometimes I Hate You

title.native: リリィと機械じかけの心
運命すぎてつがえません
キス イン シェアハウス

114094.description: My name is Suzaki Aiichirou, a lone wolf and I live to fight! However, one day an annoying girl came to my house and challenged me to a duel… and since that day on my life has completely changed. This is a story about the birth of a brand-new world.

title.native: 国立超能力大学推薦選抜試験
title.romaji: Kokuritsu Chounouryoku Daigaku Suisen Senbatsu Shiken

114096.description:
The whole of London is shocked when the mayor is found dead on an Underground train, but perhaps none more than university student Al Adley. Though he took the Tube at the time of the fatal stabbing, he doesn’t remember seeing anything unusual—certainly nothing to explain how a bloody knife found its way into his pocket that night. However, in spite of this damning evidence, Detective Ellis believes Al’s claims of innocence. Now the two must work together to conceal Al’s involvement and clear his name in the face of shadowy forces working to see Al take the fall for a crime he didn’t commit...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Won the 25th Japan Media Art Festival New Face Award for Manga in 2022.
synonyms: ロスト・ラッド・ロンドン
Would You like to Meet Me Next Time?

title.native: 今度会ったら××しようか
0229～スロウリィ・ロング・ライフ～

114100.description: Kiichi Nakai, CEO of Heartful Company, is confronted with a grim diagnosis.To make the most of his final days, he commits to only carrying out good deeds. Here begins a tale of love and passion for doing the right thing, a story to warm even the coldest of hearts.

title.native: 虐殺!!! ハートフルカンパニー

114101.description: Haruna has some problems with her boyfriend... He doesn't pay her enough attention! The kid she's tutoring certainly notices her... How's a girl supposed to know her man loves her!?
synonyms: Until I Turn Around the Corner

title.native: 通りの角を曲がるまで
title.romaji: Toori no Kado wo Magaru made

114102.description: This mafia gangster is so wonderfully awkward that it's hard not to love him. He's in love with a Bentou seller. Although in business, notorious, and famous for his fighting power, he doesn't even dare to speak to this seller. Can he overcome this inexplicable shyness?

114103.description: Two girls enjoy a trip to the beach together. They laugh, strip and kiss among the waves.

114104.description:
Everyone dreams of getting into Glory Hill, the university where successful applicants are guaranteed fame and fortune. Being looked up to as role models, the people of Korea are anxious to see what will become of the five new students which have been accepted. Watching from a distance a boy sits at the bus stop with an indescribable look etched onto his face.

(Source: K.I.S.S.)

114128.description:
College is supposed to be for fun, learning, and experiencing new things. One of these things could be witnessing your TA and professor getting it on. And what about this new freshman? She might be interested in me...

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: シークレットカノジョ

114134.description:
There is one lone wolf who lives deep in the forest. There is one young man who just wants to keep on living. What connects them? Why does the wolf look so sad? And why does the heart of the man beat so fast? A forbidden love story between a noble beast and young samurai starts here.

Note: Includes the one-shot "ΑΩ".

114135.description:
Taken advantage of by an unseen entity...
An arrogant problem student and his teacher who can see ghosts...
Pleasure that'll make anyone shudder! A horror-themed boys' love tale

Dead bodies found left and right, mysterious rumors, a town with a bewitching legend...
Reiji Hizuki is your ordinary, run-of-the-mill language arts teacher filling in for his predecessor who suddenly vanished one day... At least, he's supposed to be. Kyoichi Magaki is one of his problem students... Kyoichi tells Reiji he's pretty and wants to bang him, then proceeds to pounce. Reiji's fellow teacher follows with his own hunt as more and more strange events unfurl... What will happen to Reiji!? What should he do!? Be careful, Mr. Hizuki!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Teacher! Let's Have A Scary Story?
อาจารย์ มาเล่าเรื่องผีกันไหม

title.english: Got Any Ghost Stories, Mr. Hizuki?
title.native: 先生、怖い話しませんか

114137.description:
When her mother, the mistress of a multimillionaire, passes away, Belle worries about how she'll raise her little half siblings. Then the multimillionaire's oldest son, Cristo Ravelli, appears. Belle feels bashful when faced with his fine features and sinfully beautiful eyes, but her heart freezes the instant she hears his proposal. He coldly commands her to put the children up for adoption and end all ties with the Ravelli family. Belle was desperately trying to protect her young family, but Cristo hid ulterior motives behind his beautiful eyes. He will only look after the children, he says, if Belle becomes his wife...

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: 愛妾の娘 大富豪の飽くなき愛 I
大富豪の飽くなき愛 I
Aishou no Musume: Daifugou no Akunaki Ai I

114138.description:
"You act like this is our first time together." We had only just met when my neighbor Kamiya said that to me... - Shii Hayama, 27 years old, is an office worker at an advertisement company. With the intense workload she has, taking the last train home late at night is just part of her routine. One such night, a man she doesn’t know wakes Shii up after she drifted asleep on the train. She later discovers that this man was her new neighbor, Azusa Kamiya. Even though they’ve just met, how is it that he knows her body inside and out?! This Kamiya guy is hiding an astonishing secret...!

(MangaPlaza)

title.english: It's Because You Keep Doing xx
title.romaji: Kimi ga Nandomo xx Suru Kara

114139.description:
They could never turn back time… There was nothing between them anymore!
Betsy and her Greek multimillionaire husband are in the middle of divorce proceedings! Betsy wanted to have a baby with the man she loves from the bottom of her heart. But then she found out the unthinkable truth: Nik had gotten a vasectomy! She should’ve known he’d never want a baby with a poor girl like her! Betsy was living on her own as they worked through their divorce when Nik showed up out of the blue and they shared a night of passion. Many weeks later, she’s still grappling with her feelings for him when she begins to notice changes in her body!

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: Grecia-shiki Ai no Tousou: Daifugou no Akunaki Ai II
ギリシア式愛の闘争 大富豪の飽くなき愛 II
大富豪の飽くなき愛 II

114140.description:
Ella is shocked to find out that her older brother has borrowed a huge amount of money from Zarif. Who’s Zarif? He’s the king of the desert country Vashir and someone who just happened to propose to Ella three years earlier. Ella loved him, but after realizing that he just wanted a physical relationship to create an heir, she turned him down. After her father’s business received a bankruptcy notice, Ella’s mother collapsed. Feeling disgraced and humiliated, Ella goes back to Zarif for help, but he has one condition…a limited-time love affair! In order to preserve the king’s image, the two pretend to be married for a year. Is this Zarif’s revenge for her rejecting his proposal?

(Source: Harlequin)
synonyms: 麝香と薔薇 大富豪の飽くなき愛 III
Zakou to Bara: Daifugou no Akunaki Ai III
大富豪の飽くなき愛 III

114141.description:
Saori, who is devoted to her work as a fashion-designer and has never been in love, happens to meet three handsome guys at a bar. Saori's peaceful life will never be the same...

(Source: Berry's Comics, translated)

114142.description:
If Kei only falls for the worst kinds of bad boys, how should she avoid her fate? By not falling in love, of course! After her latest ex-boyfriend breaks her heart by leaving her for his pregnant lover, Kei swears up and down that she’s never going to let herself go through that again. This time, she says, as she starts a purely physical relationship with her boss Sakuma, it’s going to be different – but can she really stop herself from falling in love with him?

(Source: Manga Planet)
synonyms: I'm gonna be in love with my boss tonight

title.native: クールな副社長の甘すぎる愛し方
title.romaji: Cool na Fukushacho no Amasugiru Aishikata

114144.description:
Office worker Shiho, age 28, plays the go-getter career woman so well that everyone at work calls her the "Iron Lady." Feeling uneasy about her relationship with her boyfriend Ken, Shiho takes the leap and invites him to a company party, but as the party begins he's still not there... In that moment, her handsome coworker, and heir to the company, Miyagi strikes up a conversation with her. Miyagi is a big hit among the female employees, but Shiho has always treated him casually, never taking much interest in his charms. However, when she runs into him again on the way to the bathroom, the usual sweet and chipper Miyagi is nowhere to be found! His speech is rougher, and he's dropped the workplace niceties, and on top of that he backs her up against the wall, blocking her retreat with his body...?! An office romance with a high-class bachelor, at once wicked and earnest, who just might be her Mr. Right!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Merciless Teasing from a High-Class Suitor
title.native: 腹黒御曹司がイジワルです

synonyms: 0 Distance love affair with forcible man

title.native: 強引なカレと0距離恋愛
title.romaji: Gouin na Kare to 0 Kyori Renai

114146.description: Working at a construction company, 21-years old Riko has no experience in love but would like to fall in love. Kotetsu, her boss and childhood friend who is 8 years older, is cool and good looking, but because they share a sibling-like relationship, the chances of any development are zero…. And yet one day, as Riko returns from a mixer, Kotetsu suddenly says “I’ll take all of your firsts” and takes away her first kiss…! After that, Riko was driven into a corner by Kotetsu who would come on to her in the office whenever there was a chance. Could it be that I’m just being made fun of…? Despite thinking that, her heart just wouldn’t stop racing!

title.english: No, Thank You to Your Doting Love
title.native: その溺愛、お断りします

114148.description:
Miho is a 28-year-old office worker who is uprooting her whole life and moving to the countryside from Tokyo in order to change who she is. The night before she leaves, she meets Osamu, falling for him instantly, and they spend the night together. A few months after she has started her new job, her company asks her to become the executive secretary to the new managing director, who turns out to be no other that Osamu himself! Miho has left her flashy and luxurious ways behind and looks completely different from when they first met in Tokyo, and she is desperate to keep her identity a secret from him. To top it off, she has put in place a strict NO DATING rule, so she is doing everything she can to squash down any feelings she might have towards him... Meanwhile, unaware of her secret efforts, Osamu continues to chase after her with his "Have we met before?" accusations!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: The managing director is chasing me!

title.english: The Managing Director is Chasing After Me
title.native: 専務が私を追ってくる！

synonyms: Tell me the reason for that kiss

title.native: 速水社長、そのキスの理由を教えて
title.romaji: Hayami Shacho, Sono Kiss no Riyuu wo Oshiete

114151.description:
What becomes of love when it starts as a facade…?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: My Secret's in the Hands of a Wicked Prince
title.native: 腹黒王子に秘密を握られました
title.romaji: Haraguro Ouji ni Himitsu wo Nigiraremashita

114152.description:
One day, Kanon, a sober office lady with no love experience, gets transferred to the sales department, where the top 3 most handsome guys in her company happen to be. There's the prince-like one, the cool one and the mysterious one... Although Kanon has gone fairly unnoticed in the office until now, her life suddenly takes a huge turn! For some reason, the cool and reticent Manager Konou who she works closely with is exclusively kind to her... While Kanon is absolutely captivated by his smile, which only seems to come out when he's around her. Could this be... love?!

An incident at a welcome party brings these 2 much closer together...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

114154.description:
Tokyo Mew Mew 2020 Re-Turn is a two-part one-shot manga by the two original creators: the story writer Reiko Yoshida and the illustrator Mia Ikumi.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

Note: Includes two side stories.

title.native: 東京ミュウミュウ 2020 り・たーん

114155.description:
Jin Inohara’s life as a veteran adult industry actor is sleeping with someone new. But, when he becomes an actor for the Cherry Bonbon series, Jin finds himself paired up long term with Hikaru Amou. Jin and Hikaru’s videos sell well, and they gain popularity as a pair, leading to more and more videos of them together. Yet, despite their intimacy on screen, Jin and Hikaru don’t know much about each other’s private lives. That is...until Jin realizes he lives in the same apartment building as Hikaru. This volume also includes Maki Marukido’s debut work, “Wednesday Morning, 3:30 A.M.”

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: Even If You Close Your Eyes, You Can See the Light
title.native: 目を閉じても光は見えるよ
title.romaji: Me wo Tojitemo Hikari wa Mieru Yo

114156.description: A university student is threatened by an unknown old man. "I hate people like you! Your fate is to die," said the man with an undisguised persecution complex. To escape this hurt, I’ll do only enjoyable things till my end! he argues, in his extreme desperation. In the midst of his delusions, the man propositions him, saying, "Do you want to have sex?" while he takes off his clothes. Then, little by little, he begins to find the suffering face of the man cute?! "Welcome home! The rice will be done in 30 minutes, so shall we have sex?" "You should hurry up and escape from here...!" Can love bloom in this lifestyle of confinement? An incredible five-chapter compilation by the one and only Kimura Hidesato!

title.native: 今夜、上司に抱かれます

114159.description: The story begins with a strange girl named Yomi who revives Iori, a man who was stabbed to death by someone in the street, and he dies if he doesn't kiss Yomi regularly. He helps Yomi to find a stolen spell book.

114160.description:
Life beyond death...A foolish notion with which to deceive oneself. But what happens when death does not come? Hanbei the Undying has lived longer than most, yet he’s found no sense of purpose along the way—no reason to swing his blade. With a history vaster than most could hope to comprehend, it’s only natural to wonder: Who exactly was he before he met the Wolf? Find out in this must-read tale for fans of FromSoftware’s hit game SEKIRO: Shadows Die Twice!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Sekiro Historia Extra: Hanbei, el Inmortal

title.english: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying
title.native: SEKIRO 外伝　死なず半兵衛

114161.description:
He's unfriendly and uncouth, yet his kisses are as sweet as his desserts... Neither body nor soul can resist this Italian beauty... Keito is a chef at the privately managed Italian restaurant "Molte Stelle." He's been asked to supervise a new hire, the Italian dessert specialist Gino. Gino's an inscrutable man of few words, and Keito is constantly at his wit's end trying to settle him in. One day, Gino leaps on him and steals a rich, syrupy kiss...!

(Source: Renta!)

114162.description: Hajime’s friend, Yoshita is a cross-dresser who likes to upload his photos on social media. Hajime, feeling concerned about his friend, volunteered to be the “only audience” for Yoshita’s pictures. How will Hajime deal with all of this when Yoshita is actually his first love?
synonyms: You are the cutest in the world.

title.native: 世界でいちばんかわいい！

114163.description:
A sultry love and hate story between two former gang brothers.

Pissed off by his surly face, he wants to see him writhe in pleasure.
Ginji Shirogane's the leader of the recently founded Shirogane gang, and he's got it out for Ittetsu Karasuba, boss of the Atagi gang and former gang brother slash mentor to Ginji. It's been years since that fateful day when Ittetsu turned his back on him. Ginji calls him to his bar, where he orders his men to make a woman out of Ittetsu. This was the only way to break the steadfast Ittetsu, who can more than handle a little pain. However, despite not fighting back, he manages to withstand the onslaught of pleasure, which only drives Ginji's obsession and distorted carnal desire to a whole new level...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: spilt milk -スプリット・ミルク-

114164.description:
They’ve been married one month already, but Soijiro’s new wife Chiyo has maintained a fake smile every day since. She says and gives away so little, in fact, the insecure samurai can’t help but worry whether she’s dissatisfied with the arranged match. Ever the beautiful and dutiful wife, Chiyo seems much too good for him — a lowly second son — so he swears to become the husband she deserves. Little does he know, however, the head-over-heels Chiyo is desperately trying to keep her wild attraction to him in check for propriety’s sake.

How could she not love a handsome husband who cherishes and protects her with all his heart?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Notes:
- Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kodansha for commercial release.
- Includes 26 extra chapters.
synonyms: My New Wife is Forcing Herself to Smile
嫁過來的妻子總是在諂笑

title.native: 嫁いできた嫁が愛想笑いばかりしてる
title.romaji: Totsuidekita Yome ga Aisouwarai Bakari shiteru

114165.description: A short two chapters twitter series about Haruma and Misaki, a newlywed couple.
synonyms: The Story Of A Couple Who Wants To Kiss

title.native: いってきますのキスがしたい夫婦の話
title.romaji: Itte Kimasu no Kiss ga Shitai Fuufu no Hanashi

114166.description: Two high school classmates play a bushed filled, romantic game of cat and mouse.
synonyms: The Seasoned Tactician vs. The Amateur Strategist

title.native: 駆け引きが強い人と弱い人
title.romaji: Kakehiki ga Tsuyoi Hito to Yowai Hito

114167.description:
Momoka, a secretary involved in an office romance, quit her job due to a broken heart.
She begins working as a housekeeper and finds out that her new employer is Mr. Mizusawa, the vice president of her former company! Although he once brought her to a party and forced her to pose as his girlfriend, Momoka gradually discovers Mizusawa's gentler side and becomes attracted to him.
Indulge in the forbidden romance between a housekeeper and a control-freak vice president!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 俺様副社長に捕まりました。

114168.description:
Chizuru has no idea why she was suddenly transferred to the secretarial department of her company until she has a one-on-one meeting with the Chair of the Board. Apparently, she's supposed to help make the hot-but-womanizing Executive Director Soji Hayama get married within a year. Chizuru tries as hard as she can to nudge Soji toward one of his fianc?e candidates, but to no avail. He doesn't seem to want to get married at all. In fact, he keeps giving Chizuru special treatment, and now people think she's the one he wants to marry! Thanks to him, her life is full of drama now, but little by little, she finds herself drawn to him...

A Cinderella story between an office worker who's "just your average girl" and a rich, hot, womanizer!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ヒールの折れたシンデレラ

114169.description:
A handsome surgeon and nurse's secret relationship?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

114170.description: In the corner of an office building, there is a certain stall-village - the "Lunch Garden" - where Haruto runs a curry stall. Yashima, his rival, runs a soup curry stall; a good-looking man with excellent skills, whose stall is always flocked with female customers. Self-conscious Haruto picks fights with him non-stop whenever they meet. Suddenly, due to certain circumstances, the sponsors/organizers decided to suspend Haruto's stall?! Haruto, still disturbed and shaken by the news, was surprised when Yashima, who was supposed to be his rival, unexpectedly stood up for him...?!

title.native: 食べられちゃう系男子。

114171.description:
A young man whose dream was shattered, an elite salesman, a hooker, and a mysterious novelist and his daughter are living together in a 4-bedroom house! You can see the kindness, sadness, and hatred of people only in a group of strangers...

A human drama about the lives of four men a one girl unfolds in the corner of a city.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

synonyms: El amor te inclina hacia delante

title.native: プレイバック・アイラブユー
早部さんは今日も待てない
塩麹さんは恥を知らない
チェリパイア伸縮日録
リトルボーイミーツリトルガール

114185.description:
Even though Ayumi is not feminine at all, Ayumi is hiding a secret about her identity...

Ayumi, being a definition of a tomboy, has always been ridiculed by this. A certain kouhai photographer, however, out of the blue confesses his admiration to her... and to be a model for a photography contest! Ayumi cannot comprehend how someone finds her true self admirable, wouldn't her model self be a better choice?

title.native: さつえい条件キミ限定。

114186.description: The story of a man who brings good luck and those who get carried away. Jung WonHo, an office worker who spent a normal day, accidentally saves Ji TaeWoo from a car accident. WonHo is attracted to TaeWoo, who saw the accident as a chance to approach him, and now the two are getting closer...

114187.description:
Yoshida, a rookie half-elf courier, struggles day after day with troublesome assignments. Faced with stubborn mages, motley townsfolk swarming around the hero’s party, and corrupt forest wardens, can she safely carry out her duties? This fantasy tale does not concern heroes nor sages, but nameless working folk. Let the stories of the struggles of ordinary laborers unfold!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.english: The Dragon, the Hero, and the Courier

114188.description:
Ever since she was little, Ishihara has had a "thing" for women's legs. In fact, she became vice-president of the student council just so she could spend more time admiring president Kurosaki's shapely, kissable limbs. But when the worshipper and the worshipped are locked in a room with one another, a misunderstanding gives way to unspeakable desire...

(Source: Anime-Planet)

114189.description:
Support Sexual Relation = Are you interested in sex with compensation?

(Source: fakku)

title.native: アタシに課金してみない？

synonyms: I am addicted to his lies.

title.romaji: Joushi no Uso to Oboreru Koi

synonyms: Because You Always Laugh with Me

title.native: 君がつられて笑うから

114193.description:
Kotobuki has been asked to handle a meeting with her company's business partner. But their sales agent, who is extremely handsome by the way, turns out to be none other than Tsuzuki, Kotobuki's high school classmate from 8 years ago! Back then, everyone knew him as the heir to a large corporation, and he was incredibly popular, always surrounded by girls. By comparison, Kotobuki was modest and unassuming. She absolutely dreaded dealing with Tsuzuki, who would often pick on her. Though terrified at first, as Kotobuki continues working with Tsuzuki, she realizes that he's changed. Could this be the budding of an unexpected romance?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Tsuzuki: From Bad Boy to Sweetheart in 8 Years
title.native: ８年後の都筑くんが甘すぎる

114197.description:
Gimme the carrot between your legs! ❤

(Source: fakku)

114198.description:
At the brink of death on an otherworldly battlefield, Jihoo Seol is granted the chance to relive his life. But all magic has its limits, and Seol only retains a few fragments of the man he will become. Memories of a future he has yet to live manifest in sporadic dreams and magic grants him unearned luck. When his magic fails, Seol's life takes a turn for the worse. Desperate and alone, he's approached by a mysterious woman with an offer that will change his life forever. Will his dreams be enough to save him from the horrors that lie ahead?

(Source: Tapas)

114199.description:
How do you explain your dreams to someone? How do you explain your nightmares? A collection of stories to lull you into the world of dreams... or nightmares.

"Nightmare in the Art Room": Rumors have been spreading throughout the school that Mr. Hizuki has a mysterious power that awakens his sixth sense. But that is exactly what drew Miyamae to ask Mr. Hizuki to be a model for his next painting. Reluctantly, Mr. Hizuki accepts and proceeds to spend intimate time with Miyamae... (Warning: Psychological horror and Rape)

"Suspicious Sleep Paralysis": Mr. Hizuki is having sixth sense problems again. But this time, they're more than just dreams. Have you ever experienced the sensations of the dream world even though you are wide awake? (Warning: Sexual assault)

"Library Molester": Clearly, Mr. Hizuki is a popular teacher. Guys and ghosts love him. So what will he do when they come for him all at once? (Warning: Rape)

"Eat Up!": Ohsaki has a food fetish. When he sees whipped cream on Sato's body, it makes him want to whip his cream. His lust is so ravenous that it becomes contagious, making Sato question his own desires.

"It's Not a Joke!": Takahane is a bright and beautiful worker, as opposed to the unkept Saito, who seems angry all the time. What will blossom between the two opposites when Takahane sticks to Saito for months on end?

"Fascination": Mr. Karasuma wanders into a desolate village and decides to stay at a quiet inn with a hot spring, managed by a beautiful master. Mr. Karasuma enjoys everything but the bugs. He can't stand them. What can he do when he finds a bug has made its way into his yukata? (Warning: Rape)

(Source: Futekiya)

114200.description:
"I like you, please go out with me."

The romantically-challenged history teacher Suzuki-sensei has finally received her first confession of love!? But wait, her suitor Watanuki is just a high school student, and they're both girls, too! So she can't possibly accept the sudden confession? As a student of history, Suzuki-sensei will have to rely on the teachings of the warlord Uesugi Kenshin for advice on how to navigate the battlefield of love!

I got reunited with Kuroki, a girl whom I had feelings for from some years back.

I'm confused by the very different aura she has compared to then, and while I'm still finding my bearings around her, she asks me to let her stay at my place for today...
As thanks Kuroki will service me for free, but this girl has a secret...

A vivid and fierce up-and-coming appearance!! Betty-sensei draws a story about forming a kind and warm bond with a girl who seeks warmth.

(Source: FANZA, translated)

114326.description: I didn't care that I was being cunning, as long as you smiled. I was fine with being a replacement, as long as I could be by your side. If it was the sole reason to stay by you who had lost everything, then things were fine... that's... how it should have been.

114327.description:
After losing her parents, Mio's dream of becoming a pianist was all but taken from her. Now, she works as a house keeper at Arc en Ciel, a luxury hotel in the heart of the city. One day, a flurry of expected events introduces Mio to Taisei, the heir to Arc en Ciel. The next thing she knows, she is accompanying him to the hotel's anniversary party -- as his lover! The task? To put an end to his arranged engagement! On top of that, Mio has to continue to pretend to be Taisei's fiance even after the party is over...?! A story of the sweet adoration that grows between one brave housekeeper and the successor to a luxury hotel!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

114328.description:
“You rescued me from a world without sound. If it wasn’t for you, I never would’ve known the world was such an amazing place!”

Because of a hearing disability, university student Kohei had made a habit of distancing himself from those around him. But after meeting the exceedingly cheerful Taichi, he gradually begins to embrace a more positive outlook on life. Kohei eventually begins to see Taichi as more than a friend, and after he finally confesses his love to Taichi, the feelings become mutual.

In this new addition to the I Hear the Sunspot series, Kohei continues on as a student, while Taichi makes his way out into the working world to pursue his own calling and the two begin a new life together!

(Source: One Peace Books)

Note: Contains four extras.

114329.description:
Due to the overwhelming success of I Hear the Sunspot, the sequel has finally arrived, I Hear the Sunspot: Theory of Happiness! How will this "more than friends, less than lovers" relationship evolve?

"He can't hear...?"

Because of a hearing disability Kohei is often alone. Taichi is outspoken and cheerful. At first, Kohei keeps himself well guarded, but after he meets Taichi he slowly learns to open up.

(Source: One Peace Books)

114330.description:
After taking him in on that rainy day, the mysterious Ryo now lives with the mad hatter, Kutsuna. With his stellar staff's help, business has been booming. However, one fateful day, Kutsuna's rival and long-time friend Gotou informs him that he has been entered into New York Fashion Week. Initially Kutsuna was hesitant to travel, but over time he steels his resolve. Once in New York, Kutsuna encounters some of Ryou old acquaintances...

(Source: KUMA)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

A spin-off of the main series that follows some of Ryou's gang acquaintances.

114348.description:
Yuuta and Ritsu have been playing baseball together since they were children, but after being defeated in a local tournament over the summer, they must retire from the high school team to study for university entrance exams. Still, Yuuta finds himself unable to give up his lingering attachment to baseball. The one person who can truly understand him is Ritsu, who has been acting worryingly distant since they quit the team. But there's something Yuuta himself doesn't understand... Does he think of Ritsu as his partner in the way that a teammate would, or is the affection between them something stronger?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114349.description:
The year is Taisho 8 (1919). Yuzuki, a village girl, was about to marry Yuichiro, the heir of the Kaguragi clan, which has ruled their village for generations. But facing a spreading epidemic, Yuzuki and Yuichiro decide to hibernate for a year by taking the poisonous plant called "tokohana," that is supposed to have the "power to stop time." But when Yuzuki wakes up from her long sleep, a shocking new reality awaits her.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: The volume includes a bonus chapter and two additional one-shots.

114350.description:
A miraculous love story about the full bloom of adolescence!

Notes:
- Includes seven extra chapters.
- Includes the one-shot "Kimi e no Ai ga Tomannai!"

114352.description: That summer I was still a junior high school student. I was standing between two worlds. One day, when I woke up, I was a junior high school student in an unknown world. -Itoigawa summer. The first person I spoke to in a world that doesn't speak language is a man with with a prostethic legs and a square face. According to the man's explanation, it seems that in the summer, the world called "inner" has lost itself to this world "egg" ...!?

114354.description:
Science geek Yuuhi Toganou has just invented the girl of his dreams, Momo-chan! But right as he anticipates losing his virginity to his creation, gyaru girl Sara Ayanokouji interrupts him and pushes the button that activates Momo-chan. Yuuhi's creation explodes, and when the dust settles, he finds out that he and Sara have switched bodies! Sara is calm about it, saying she's always wanted to be a boy, and she has plans of doing everything it means to be a man, including sex! Will Yuuhi's former body lose its virginity before his soul does?!

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Kagakushitsu no Himegoto

114356.description:
New employee Shiho Satoko has a special skill. Rather than being able to read the mood, it would be better to say she can "see" it. With this special skill, what kind of hidden side can she see behind her senior's unfriendly exterior?

Note: Sixteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

114359.description:
Yoshitake, this world’s horniest man, saved a planet by losing his virginity to and having a child with Lune, the alien who came to Earth in order to prevent the extinction of her species! And thus ends our epic tale, but…what of the other members of Yoshitake’s harem?

There’s the orally fixated Haruka, who never went all the way despite being Yoshitake’s official girlfriend, and the delicate-but-pushy older sister and good drinking buddy Mika! Nor can we forget Levelane, Lune’s younger sister who treated Yoshitake as an enemy, or Rima, the big-boobed alien bimbo who raced to Earth to use her devilish body as a weapon. After Lune returns to her homeworld, what is left for Yoshitake? The answer to that question may just lead to a happy ending for them all!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

In contrast to her sister model, Sena Narumi, Mona is an ordinary high school girl. An idol story with HoneyWorks as original and Mogelatte as mangaka!

114362.description:
In the year 2185 AD, the immigrant ship of the same name, Eden 2185, entered space travel for 100 years with the aim of emigrating to a planet with an environment similar to the earth, Eden 2185. In it, the same environment as the earth is maintained, people live normally, get older, and eventually age. Sid Johan will be the next-generation pilot of the ship and will be exploring Eden's voyage and gaining experience.

The series is compromised of the following stories:
1. Eden 2185 (エデン２１８５)
2. Satsui no Soko (殺意の底)
3. Eden no Kokkai (エデンの国境)
4. Furuhoshi no Gotoku ni (ふる星のごとくに)
5. Umi ni Eien (宇宙に永遠)

114363.description:
While most of the smaller Pokémon are taking a nap, Togepi suddenly wakes up and, after seeing a group of flying Pokémon, finds itself separated from the rest of the Pokémon. Noticing this, Pikachu, Bulbasaur, Squirtle, Venonat, Marill, and Psyduck go in search of Togepi. It is there that they meet Elekid, who leads them to a group of Exeggcute. However, one such Exeggcute has a missing egg, and believes Togepi to be their missing part. Thus, the gang must travel to find the missing egg, and endure a storm that could blow Togepi and the Exeggcute away.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ピカチュウたんけんたい
だいすき♡ポケットモンスター

114365.description:
The story is about Hinata and her friends, the only people who know about a secret pool. Where they are playing, they find a suspicious attache case at the bottom of the water. The manga is a story of the maze-like, mixed-up world of youthful, lazy days.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: É Um Bom Dia Para Um Labirinto!
C'est une belle journée pour un labyrinthe !

114366.description:
One day, an asylum in a large hole is discovered in Antarctica. At the same time, the mysterious coma-inducing illness Randolph's Syndrome begins spreading around the world. Many countries sent an investigation squad to the asylum, believing it to be the cause of the disease, but not a single person safely returned. Sergiu Sol, a boy with a special resistance to the disease, and Antarctica's jack-of-all-trades Hildegard Olympiada Yamada, decide to take on the challenge of the large hole without a map, but...!? What is the cause of the coma-inducing disease? What in the world is the asylum? Go down to the deep, jet-black bottom, one with insanity.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114383.description:
16-year-old super-studier Nagi Umino, second-year student at the Meguro River Academy high school, was switched at birth. On his way to a dinner to meet his birth parents, he accidentally meets the brash, outspoken, Erika Amano, who is determined to make Nagi her fake boyfriend as she never wants to actually marry. But once Nagi makes it to dinner, he finds his parents have decided to resolve the hospital switch by conveniently having him marry the daughter his birth parents raised...who turns out to be none other than Erika herself!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Fourteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category
synonyms: รักอลวนคนสลับบ้าน

114384.description:
Good grief. After spending years traveling across the world, saving towns, defeating demons, and then finally killing the demon king, my party—the people I considered comrades—decided to kick me out. I’d honestly thought that they’d be different. They wouldn’t be like the rest of the world, who irrationally hate people like me, with Amber Eyes. But...I was wrong. In the end, it’s not their fault, though. It’s just how the world was back then. I was sure that with more time and understanding, the world would shed their preconceived notions about those with Amber Eyes and treat us as they would anyone else. I held on to this hope as I used my unique magecraft to reincarnate myself two hundred years into the future. Now, it’s time to find out if my guess was right!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

114385.description:
Reika is a mangaka who channels her horniness into her work. But when she finally meets her deadlines, she relies on her brother to let the steam off...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Notes:
• Released at Comic Market 95, 96, 100.
• A live-action AV adaptation (NIMA-047) was released on January 17th, 2025

114386.description:
Werewolves - For centuries they wagged their tails and served the vampires. But no more! As payback for his missing father, werewolf Phil decides to exact sweet revenge on the bloodsuckers.

Undercover, he is employed as a butler by the most dangerous and famous vampire, Eric Beaufort. But no matter how hard he tries, Eric is not just unexpectedly friendly and kindhearted, all the usual anti-vampire tools are useless against him. How is Phil supposed to get rid of his new master?

114387.description: A complication of summer love about provocative husband.

114388.description:
Prince Bojji is the eldest son of a king. But while both his parents are giants, he himself is a pipsqueak too feeble to so much as swing a dagger. To make matters worse, the whole kingdom gossips that the deaf, non-speaking Bojji is unfit to inherit the throne. The prince's days seem empty. But when a chance meeting unites Bojji with Kage, a new friend who truly understands him, his life begins to shine.

(Source: BookWalker)

114391.description:
Akari couldn't think less of her school's karate champ, Abe-kun, despite him being the national champion. He's giant, uncouth, and couldn't be more different than her sweet angel and childhood friend, Takuto. But when Abe-kun injures his arm protecting her, she takes it upon herself to get him healed—after all, the school's pride is at stake—but finds the tables suddenly turned when he confesses to her! Now she's the goal he's aiming for, and she'll soon find out how driven a national champion can be!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 阿部くんに狙われてます

114392.description:
Weber Yates's dreams of stardom are about to be reduced to a ranch hand’s job in Texas, and his one relationship is with a guy so far out of his league he might as well be on the moon. Or at least in San Francisco, where Weber stops to see him one last time before settling down to the humble, lonely life he figures a frog like him has coming.

Cyrus Benning is a successful neurosurgeon, so details are never lost on him. He spotted the prince in a broken-down bull rider's clothing from day one. But watching Weber walk out on him keeps getting harder, and he’s not sure how much more his heart can take. Now Cyrus has one last chance to prove to Weber that it's not Weber's job that makes him Cyrus's perfect man, it's Weber himself. With the help of his sister's newly broken family, he’s ready to show Weber that the home the man’s been searching for has always been right there, with him. Cyrus might have laid down an ultimatum once, but now it's turned into a vow—he's never going to let Weber out of his life again.

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

114393.description:
Twenty-six-year-old Keiichi just got out of his dreadful former job, so it's no surprise that the sight of his abusive ex-boss still makes him run for the hills - and right into a strangely horror-themed bar. There, he meets Miyako, a kimono-clad beauty who lets him air out his grievances, and her quiet charm and love for horror stories has Keiichi so smitten that he wishes he can meet her again. But will he still want to be around her even after finding out the real reason behind her kindness that night?

(Source: Manga Planet)

114395.description:
Even though it's against the school rules for students to date, Tsukimi and Takagi have been going steady in secret for a whole 6 months. On a date at the amusement park, they finally share their first kiss, only for it to be caught on camera by an interloper. When the would-be paparazzo threatens to show the faculty, Tsukimi, being the good girl she is, goes along with his demands in order to preserve her and her boyfriend's academic standing.

(Source: Fakku!)

114396.description:
Humans intermingle with beings from the parallel world of "Shinkinkai." The "Buddyfight" game chooses humans ("Buddyfighters") and partners them with Buddy Monsters from Shinkinkai, and the duo fight against other Buddyfighters. The battles in these games can sometimes even influence the fate of nations. Gaō Mikado is a sixth-year student at the "Aibo Academy" elementary division who longs to be a Buddyfighter and to be partnered with a Monster. One day Gaō notices a young boy being bullied by delinquents, and he helps him out using his Aiki-jujutsu skills. Drum Bunker Dragon, a Monster and the son of the hero of Dragon World, watches Gaō's actions, and decides to form a pact with him as his buddy.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114397.description: Years after his father's disappearance, Okada Masao, whose own life is going poorly, learns about how his father lived the last few years of his life. With nothing left to lose, he decides to live alone in the forest himself.

114398.description: Magical girl Vanilla was dismissed when she was just 18 years old because the king is a lolicon?! Vanilla didn't want to be separated from her familiar, Black Mike, so he suggested that they run away together! Pursued by many, Vanilla gradually discovers her feelings for Black Mike during this chaotic situation.

114400.description:
The morning after a meteor fell in Japan, a mysterious beautiful transfer student Monika appears in front of Leo Kuroishi, an ordinary high school student. But the moment she told him "I will protect you," Leo's problem-free days changed forever. What is the value of life? The fate of humanity? A new disaster action manga begins!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

114403.description:
Their red thread is twisted and tangled.

Even though they were supposed to be engaged, linked by an arranged marriage between their families, they do not get along with each other at all. Whenever they meet, they always get annoyed at each other and argue, even though their feelings might be at odds with their words.

"I don't think he/she likes me anyway."
That's what they thought, these two people who can't be honest with their feelings. But deep inside, the arrows in their hearts are pointed straight at each other!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

Originally uploaded to Pixiv and later serialized by GANGANpixiv.
Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

114404.description:
Once a year, the strongest delinquent students gather for Kenka Fes (Fight Festival) and compete for their school to come out on top. A rumor is spreading that Karikari Academy, a regular participant, is withdrawing from this year's competition. After hearing the news, other high schools begin to drop out. It looks like this year's event will be cancelled. However, one reckless delinquent is determined persevere and do whatever it takes to enter the festival.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114408.description: Mei Takigawa, the daughter of a late great forger, goes to the palace of Duke Ranswell to try to recover a brooch forged by his father. The duke agrees to return the brooch to her; before this happens, however, Mei will have to behave as if she were his bride until he is in Japan.

114409.description: Because of an order from her grandfather who works as the Grand chamberlain in the Bernadis Kingdom, Michelle took the place of her twin brother and dressed up as a man in order to apprentice as a chamberlain. His Majesty, The King’s beauty is transcending. Michelle works hard in order to not to be discovered while masquerading in mens’ clothes that she’s not used to. “You don’t listen to my orders? Raise your head.” Everyday is filled with worry and anxiety. The future for Michelle that is gradually being charmed by His Majesty The King is…

Haruma Ichinose, 17, has been popular since he was born. So popular, in fact, that he figured no one could even come close...until he met Yuki Mogami. She's tall, cool, collected, and totally makes him crazy. He may just be in love...but can he deal with falling for someone even more dashing than himself?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

114416.description:
Aijou Rentaro tried and tried again, but after asking a hundred girls out on a date, he was rejected every single time. In desperation, he prays for guidance…only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to some cosmic error! Now the god is going to set things right by making sure that Aijou gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often do with gods, the dates come with a catch: one hundred girls are destined to be Aijou’s soulmate, and unless he returns their feelings each and every time, they’ll die in horrible accidents! Sure enough, girls start confessing their love to Aijou left and right. But how is he supposed to choose?! He doesn’t want to kill anyone! When he looks at each potential soulmate, it feels like a bolt of lightning. Can someone really love a hundred other people? This hilarious romantic comedy takes the harem concept to a wild extreme!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Won second place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category

114427.description:
Back in high school, Xun An and Yang Muli’s relationship fizzled out before it even had a chance to begin. After graduating college, they reunite back at their old high school, but this time as teachers. As they rekindle their long-lost affection for one another, secrets from their days as high schoolers also begin to emerge... A love story between a gifted, but devious math teacher and a passionate, but hot-headed P.E. teacher.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Chapter count includes 22 extra chapters.

114428.description:
Manga creator Nao Sakai announced on Twitter on Saturday that they will launch a manga adaptation of the 22/7 anime on the Sunday Webry manga website on January 12. The manga will tell an original story that will not be told in the anime.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114429.description:
Cervil is a magic student with no memories of his life before he met a mysterious blond woman in an alley. Now he travels with his teacher, Ross—another student, Holt, and the beastman Coudeau for "special training"... but this field trip may not be as routine as it seems!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

114430.description:
Chizuko, who lives in Sakai City, Niigata Prefecture, is an otaku girl who is a big fan of the magical girl Berry Blossom who protects the city against the evil organisation Fossa Magna. However, nobody was worried about the battle of the two anymore because Chroma, the evil villain, was too lazy and weak.

So Chizuko decided “I want to make my magical girl shine more…!” That desire (?) leads the shy junior high school student down a strange, wicked path…

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

114431.description:
16-year-old Koharu Sakurai, from Tokyo, had stopped going to school due to certain circumstances. At the invitation of her grandmother Yoshino, Koharu ends up moving to Kyoto to live and work part-time at the general store "Sakura An" in Gion. Besides Yoshino, there’s her uncle, Soujirou, a traditional confectioner, and her second cousin, the handsome Kyoto-style gentleman Reito. Surrounded by this lively family, Koharu’s heart slowly begins to open up. However, "Sakura An" and her family seem to be hiding something...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

114432.description:
Kyouko Shinonome, the strongest delinquent girl in school. She is loved by everyone as an older sister for her perfect appearance, personality, and skills. However, Kyouko has a secret as an "older sister" that she can't let anyone know about: she loves her younger brother, Ayu!

(Source: Sunday Web Every, TL)

114437.description:
Kannawa-senpai is considered many things, but smooth is definitely not one of them. Then she meets Kamegawa, her new Kouhai. He's cute, a little nerdy, and easy to talk to. How will this awkward Senpai be able to handle these new feelings?!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

114449.description:
Sadohara Kazuha is known as the perfect girl for both boys and girls. She is also known as the professional girlfriend at school. However, little people knows that she is in love a "mobster" character, Takishima Shouto . She consults with her childhood friend, Yahagi Subaru in order to fall in love with the super-rich mobster, Takishima, and a battle for love with all sorts of tactics and strategy to win him over.

This is the opening of a twisted romantic comedy about a professional girlfriend vs. a mob guy with a 120% hassle factor!

(Source: Official Publisher, translated)

Arnold, the seventh Imperial Prince of the Adrasia Empire, is called "THE INSIPID PRINCE" among people since his twin brother is genius and respected by all people. However, he has a secret identity -SILVER, one of the only five -SS-rank adventurers in the continent. When his younger brother Leo decides to aim for the throne, Arnold starts running things behind the scenes to support his brother. Unexpectedly the most beautiful lady becomes his assistant. The secret struggle of the strongest prince begins!

(Source: Kadokawa)

Thirty-year-old Eri and twenty-year-old Wako are “roommates.” Eri is a professional writer, and Wako’s a voice actor who’s building up her reel. Having worked together and now living together, these two women in love have a nice little life for themselves! Follow this comfortable couple in a heartwarming manga tale about the everyday humor, stressors, and joys of a life shared together.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

114477.description: In Universal Century 0112, there was the Fastest Formula. They wielded the ultimate, general-purpose weapon: the F90. Seven years following the Mufti Uprising, in the surging wave of mobile suit miniaturization, there was a team operating behind the scenes. These are the records of its various operations.
