114478.description:
Five hundred years of conflict between witches and the Church has finally ended in an uneasy peace, but pockets of violent resentment linger throughout the land...

Saybil, the worst student in the short history of the Royal Academy of Magic of the Kingdom of Wenias, has no memory of his life before he enrolled. Nevertheless, Headmaster Albus sends him out into an unknown world, ordering him to take part in a special field training program in the South, where anti-witch sentiment still burns strong. Accompanying him are star pupil Hort; Kudo, the Academy's only beastfallen student; and their unusual chaperone: Loux Krystas, the ancient Dawn Witch, whose only goal is to peruse the pages of the legendary Grimoire of Zero, source of all magic. But as they journey south, nothing will be what they expected...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

114479.description: Deep inside the Earth lies a magical place called the "Healing Garden", which cared for the planet for centuries and is been protected by animal-like fairies named "Healing Animals". However, the garden was attacked by the antagonistic group called Bjögens whose goal is to infect the garden and slowly poison the planet. In order to save the Healing Garden, Latte escaped to the human world alongside three "medical trainee" Healing Animals, on a mission to find three people who can partner with them. After they meet Nodoka, Chiyu and Hinata, Latte pleaded them to fight for the Healing Garden as they became Pretty Cures in order to fight against the threat of the Bjögens and protect all life on Earth and the Healing Garden.

114480.description:
Look, it's not like Azusa doesn't want to get married. She's a wedding planner, after all, and in spite of her boss's biting sarcasm, she actually finds a lot of comfort in her job. Her boyfriend of five years, Ayumu, just hasn't really brought up the conversation, that's all. Or at least, that's what Azusa thinks, until she catches Ayumu having an affair! Though usually extremely unpleasant, Azusa's handsome boss, Kiryu, offers her sudden and uncharacteristic kindness: "If you don't get married, then I'll step in." What's that supposed to mean?! The sudden tension between Kiryu's usual offensive nature and his sweet words has Azusa wrapped around his little finger, and she's not sure if she can get away... or even wants to?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

114481.description:
After the death of her parents, Hinoko had a hard time raising her two younger brothers while working as a paralegal. One day, a handsome man named Chihiro, who claimed to be a secretary for the Mochizuki Group, a large corporation, came to visit her at work. He told her that the president of the Mochizuki Group has passed away and that Hinoko, his granddaughter, will inherit his vast fortune and the position of president of Mochizuki Group. Chihiro seemed so businesslike toward the surprised Hyuuko, but then he suddenly kissed her...? This is the start of a dramatic love story in which Chihiro is tossed about by the sweet courtship of a cool, elite secretary!

(Source: Comic Berry's, translated)

114482.description:
Light novel adaptation of the visual novel trilogy, covering Muv-Luv Extra, Unlimited and Alternative.

Shirogane Takeru is a typical high school student with a lazy attitude and a love for the virtual reality mecha battle game Valgern-on. Even though he didn't really want it, he's popular in school mainly due to his daily fights with his childhood friend (Sumika) attracting too much attention. His life takes an unexpected turn when he finds a girl named Meiya he doesn't remember ever meeting in his bed one morning. She's later revealed to be the heiress of one of the biggest corporations in Japan. She immediately moves to his house and starts changing his life for the good with her one-track-mind and unlimited resources...

(Source: VNDB)

114483.description:
Veight was reincarnated as a werewolf mage, and is now the Vice-Commander of the Demon Lord's third regiment. His task seemed simple: capture and hold a remote commercial city. But the tension caused by mankind and demonfolk coexisting is the source of endless conflict. As a former human himself, he'll need to leverage his ability to understand both sides in order to work with the human viceroy and maintain order!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

114488.description:
Margaret's life is cut short when she gets into a fatal accident at her workplace, except instead of the afterlife, she finds herself in another world! She's rescued from the brink of death by an elderly retired noblewoman who lets Margaret live at her mansion. What awaits her there is a stark contrast to her previous life: relaxed and laid-back countryside living! Sure, there's the whole fact that she was summoned to this world as a special being known as a Spirit Caller, but she couldn't care less as long as she gets to eat delicious food! She's going to get a fresh start taking life slow in this new world filled with magic and spirits!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

114491.description:
Sainen is a writer who works on urban legends. One day, he comes across Mizuki, a sloppy-looking woman who is being chased. Intrigued, he flies to her rescue and decides to take her out to dinner to find out what she is hiding, when men in uniform show up to capture her. The improbable happens when Mizuki, in contact with blood, turns into a rat to escape. Fascinated, Sainen sets out to find the beautiful woman in distress.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

114494.description:
Set in a world that has a ring encircling the planet, there is a nation that follow the tradition of chasing the shadow cast by this ring. They go as far as the ends of both northern and southern edges of the continents to accomplish their 'shadow chasing'. For what reason? Who knows. What is known about this nation is that they have been able to preserve their small nation in so small part to their advanced understanding of the 'Corona Solids', which have been utilised to build an array of creations, most notably the 'hakukai armour', which enables its user to enhance their natural ability, as well as create weapons out of this special creation. However, it seems that a storm is brewing upon this nation...

(Source: MU)

114495.description:
Kiyo works in product development at a chocolate manufacturer; she's what they call a "science type" with her white lab coat and glasses, plus her lack of romantic prospects. "I've spent my whole life focused on research, but now I want to give 'love' a try." -- Her mind made up, Kiyo registers with a matchmaking service, but the dates just keep going down in flames...

Then one day, she's met with a shocking invitation from the young and handsome president of her company, Mr. Sendo: "Would you like to go out with me? I need you." Kiyo has zero experience with romance, so this well-mannered and gallant man gazing sweetly at her as he calls her beautiful is enough to leave her reeling...! Her heart is still pounding on the day of their date, and then Mr. Sendo suddenly reveals his red-blooded, manly side and proclaims, "I'll shatter that logic of yours with my passion"...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

A high school dropout and NEET, Ayana Asakura's fate changes dramatically when Naoki Ichijou, an elite bureaucrat, discovers her talent for lateral thinking...!?

114503.description:
Once called the country of patriots, the Kingdom of Rowlands is at present, divided into the king’s loyalist faction who back the second prince – the queen consort’s son, and the church faction who back the first prince – the side consort’s son. And the court politics are in confusion.

Because of that confusion, high society’s spotlight is on who Julianna will be engaged to. The Julianna who has a unique bloodline, is known as the Perfect Lady, and is Marquis Lewis’s daughter.

One day, half a year before the announcement of Julianna’s engagement, a letter of summons was sent to Julianna from the second prince.

And then, Julianna was fiendishly proclaimed a pawn by the second prince who was supposed to have been the Ideal Prince.

In order to fulfil her own desires, Julianna reluctantly carries out her arrangement with the second prince, infiltrating the royal capital church where demon worship was happening, and becomes caught up in the conspiracy between the king’s loyalists and the church.

“I swear, with my pride as a stake, to deceive everyone and perform on this life-threatening stage.”

114506.description:
A pair of researchers stays behind on their dying planet of Eltria with their two daughters, Amitie and Kirie, in hopes of finding a way to revive the planet. But when the husband Granz falls ill it seems their dream of reviving the planet will die. Against her older sister's wishes, Kirie sets off with her childhood friend Iris to seek help from a distant alternate world. They arrive in Japan on Earth to search for the key to their planet's regeneration. There, they meet Nanoha, Fate, and Hayate.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114509.description:
A girl falsely carrying the title of honor student and demon. In order to take back past days this contract has been formed――

Snow white wings shining in the night sky. Countless lightning strikes raining from the sky. The powers that cause these paranormal phenomena are referred to as ≪Kyoui≫.

-Special ability control Academy- A institution meant to protect and educate ≪Observers≫, girls who carry unique powers. But in reaility, it's a place where these girls are being isolated, controlled and in the end, put to use. Shimon is acting as a honor student and aims to become a supervisor so he can investigate a childhood friend of his, who has been brought to one of these prison academies and had her everyday life stolen. One day he forms a contract with a girl carrying the title of a demon 『Asmodeus』, a subordinate of the institution and――.

I will definitely come and save you, even if i have to make the entire world my enemy.

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

Yuuto, an upcoming Hero has the【Magic999】status. However, now that the Demon Lord was defeated and the world has returned to peace, the boy who dedicated his youth to fighting has no ended up with his status as... 【Charm１】... due to that, he ended up spending his academy life in boredom.
One day, the【Charm999】holding former Demon Lord, the young woman Lilicia appeared. 「Won't you switch status with me? The world will be yours, you know!」
Now that Yuuto has the【Magic999】status, he quickly approached the idol of the academy, Mekuri. Has the academy life he yearned for finally begun?!
And when Lilicia and i were exposed to the remnants of the demon race..「Bring us back to the place where we belong!」Let's kick it off with 2 aims right from the beginning!!

114511.description:
Long ago, there was much war and bloodshed among the eight tribes of the world. Now with each tribe confined to its own continent, the world has achieved peace and harmony. Interaction and fighting between tribes are heavily restricted, save for one exception: the ninth continent, Duel City Babel, an arena for those wishing for conflict in peace. In the duel city, fighters from all over the world clash swords and spells, vying to be the best. Carrying on the teachings and techniques of his master, Yuri Eniastar of the Human Tribe manages to take out a high-ranking opponent on his first day. Clearly, he’s not just any new face, but unfortunately, fate has not been kind...his lineage is universally recognized as the weakest. Despite this, Yuri refuses to give up. He befriends the Beast Tribe’s Athena and the Spirit Tribe's Fram as he strives to become a peerless duelist. Welcome to an overwhelming battle fantasy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

In other words, the kaijû. Used for military purposes during the war, fallen under the control of the government after the conflicts, Mamiya tries courageously to live a normal life, she who never really knew freedom. It is in this perspective that she enters one day the world... of cinema!

114516.description:
"The other day I saw an interesting porn video, about a guy having sex with his boss."

Naoyuki Hasegawa, 37 years old. His work is perfect, but by contrast, in his private life, he’s become aware that he’s gotten out of shape.

Satoshi Katagiri, 30 years old. Handsome, smart, good personality, likes both men and women, a prince admired by all at his company. Or he should have been. He stole money from a university student, and he destroyed the car of a man he didn’t like. And secretly, he’s totally bankrupt?! One night in a park, Hasegawa meets the Katagiri that nobody knows!

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114517.description: Sano, a pure high school boy, is a virgin who wants to be popular among the ladies. In an unexpected turn of events, he meets the handsome and trendy Fujita, a university student who he respects as his “master.” When they happen to meet again in town, Fujita’s eyes were swollen with tears from a fresh break-up. While hearing Fujita out, Sano learns that he’s gay, and what’s more, Fujita makes a strong suggestion— for Sano to lose his virginity to him!

Ashigaru, knight, viking, Spartan, assassin, combat merchant... Various foot soldiers from all over the world converge on a once peaceful apartment. From the moment she woke up in a foreign land with no memories of her past, Dia knew she was fated for misery. Taken in by a baron but beaten and abused for four long years, her only friend was the eldest son of House Knolls. Everything changed when the sadistic Emperor Caire, notorious for having a macabre hobby, barged into the mansion and gazed deeply into Dia’s eyes. Soon she is whisked away to his opulent castle, where gothic nightmare of blood and lust unfolds. Could the bloodthirsty emperor hold the key to unlocking Dia’s past?

(Source: Tappytoon)

A manga adaptation of Little Women.

A 19th century tale of four very different sisters, each harboring her own hopes and ambitions for the future as their family collectively struggles to carry on in spite of their hardships.

114529.description:
This is the story of the hero who must kill the princess. This is a world where the dead are sent to the final rest by the Immortal Undertakes, a race of long-lived beings who look human. Leon, a half-breed, is the youngest of them and is on his way to take his final test when his train falls off its tracks. He meets a human girl in the forest and though he doesn't know her, he somehow feels he must protect her... from the other Undertakers!

(Source: Mangamo)

114530.description:
Takahashi-kun is really into Shimizu-san who is known to say exactly what’s on her mind to everyone. This is what happens when she's totally straightforward with him as well.

(Source: Author, translated)

Enter: a bunch of cool guys who look like they got that unapproachable swag. But let's be real—that's not the true them. They're just a bunch of dorks who've got the act down pat. So sit back, grab some popcorn and enjoy watching a bunch of goofy guys try to look cool all day every day.

(Source: Yen Press)

114536.description:
In the world of "Pian Pian", people are born with the initials of their soulmates on their bodies. The location of these "imprints" is unique to the individual, but the meaning behind the letters is the same. Suha’s happens to be located in a – ahem – very private location. The chances of actually uniting with one’s soulmates is rather slim, but that hasn’t stopped Suha. Not only does he believe he will find his soulmate, but he also refuses to date anyone until then. But lately, his handsome boss, Chef Calix, has had him feeling some feels "down there..." He thought he was alone in these feelings, but the chef has suddenly started showing interest in him. Could the tides be finally changing for innocent Suha?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A tree spirit from an unknown origin (who's actually more than a few thousand years old), infiltrates 'cold on the outside but warm on the inside' Tang Jun's life. The spirit that fell from the sky decides to live in Tang Jun's house! From then on, a series of funny events start occurring in Tang Jun's everyday life.

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

Tensions are brewing under the seemingly calm surface of the Vasilios Empire, a kingdom ruled by the Imperial Family and the Temple. When their friends Kadoi and Hasumoto reveal that they’ve been dating for a whole month, Oka and Sawada are more jealous that their friends have lovers than anything else. So, when the change in their friends’ relationship causes them to be more conscious of each other, they can’t help but wonder what it’d be like with each other—in more ways than one...

Leaving the big city to a rural beach town, Rinpei Oikawa starts a new life as an employee at a blowjob shop. Rinpei starts his new job and has Makoto Hanamura, a coworker, to keep him company and teach him the ropes. Soon after Oikawa begins working, he is recruited with Hanamura to train new employees at the oral arts. While they train the new workers, Hanamura discovers that Oikawa's erotic side he tries to keep hidden...

The manga's story begins when a peasant named Hanbee asks a girl named O-haru for her hand in marriage, but O-haru confesses that she is already thinking of another man named Masakichi from a neighboring village. 114573.description:
Tenmasou is an inn for souls whose bodies are between life and death. They rest there a while, before either continuing on or returning to the world. A woman named Izuko brings the souls of the customers to Tenmasou's peaceful doors. The inn is run by a mother and her two daughters, Nozomi and Kanae. Nozomi and Kanae are soon joined by a third half-sister, Tamae, who is the child of their father and another woman. Tamae is a 17-year-old girl who has had a difficult life, and whose body now lies in a hospital after an accident, though she doesn't realize her situation. She cheerfully helps out her sisters in the inn, but Nozomi and Kanae's mother is reluctant to accept her. The three sisters work together to help heal the souls of those that come to them.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

114574.description:
What can you do with three wishes?
Amina, one of the last wizards, loses her loved ones when her palace comes under attack. Trying to turn back time to save them, she gets stuck inside a lamp. 300 years later, Jakard, a military commander, wakes her up. He has three wishes before Amina returns to the lamp. What will he wish for?

(Source: Manta)

And Chihiro starts to have feelings for Jo who is a very unique and right kind of a guy?

On that night, she lost her purity as an innocent woman and turned into the most desolate being in the cold palace. What she asks for is only a simple, normal life but she is instead forced to fight to survive in the imperial palace, which is filled with intrigue, tricks between concubines, and competition for power and status...Is this the beginning of a love story or a tragedy which began the day they met?

The surgeon, Tang Xiaoli never thought that she had time traveled one day! When she opened her eyes after the time-travel, she saw a handsome guy was looking at her and said, "My empress, wasn't I good to you?"

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: After the Chaos, Empress in Turbulent Days!

114585.description:
In 1920s Tokyo, prodigy Kiyo has finally made it to university, only to find himself in a tough spot. He happens upon Ozaki, who invites him to live in his mansion. But is Ozaki just an eccentric recluse, or something far stranger? And what kind of relationship did he have with Kiyo's grandfather?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Yearning Fox Lies in Wait

114586.description: Touya lives a simple and satisfied life. Until a prince from a foreign island wants to stay at Touyas 1-room-apartment to experience normal japanese lifestyle. Can Touya protect the prince from danger while rejecting his approaches?

114591.description:
Behind the school, at the pool and at the staircase outside... In all these corners, someone is falling in love for the first time. Ena, who is always eating by herself, now has to save Tatsumi-senpai from his fans by having secret lunches with him?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

114592.description:
This romance starts with some bumps in the night, that turn into some truly irritating bumps in the day, that then turn into Sung-eun literally bumping into the reason for all the noise: her handsome and charming neighbor, Eun-sung. She quickly finds out that the private student representative has a somewhat questionable reputation, but that doesn’t mean she shouldn’t do her duty as the kind neighbor. I mean, they are literal neighbors, after all. She hides her true feelings to him, and the two grow so close that it isn’t long before Sung-eun has to wonder if maybe Eun-sung...is also hiding something from her?

(Source: Lezhin)

114593.description:
Ai was recently dumped by his girlfriend, is on the verge of dropping out of college, and lives in a rundown, soon-to-be-demolished apartment building. He's apathetic with no hopes or dreams for the future, wanting to just kick the bucket when he's 30. On top of that, his apartment walls are thin, making the noises of passion coming from the neighbors difficult to ignore...!!! Though shocked to learn the husky voice begging for it on a nightly basis belongs to a man, it isn't long before Aya (the beauty) and Ryo (the man's man) make him the meat in their love sandwich...!! Welcome to a world of immorality! Author Anji Seina's at their best with this dynamic and tantalizing sausage fest!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

114594.description:
Is reincarnation a coincidence or a necessity? Lu Qi has been reborn into his world where martial arts reign. With his highest level of comprehension, he obtains the most valuable treasures, searches for the heavenly dao, taks in female slaves, wipes out devils! Let’s step into this world where the primordial spirit is indestructible and the Heavenly Dao is eternal!

(Source: Mangatoon)

114595.description:
The legendary martial master Simon was betrayed by friends and persecuted to death. Three hundred years later, he reborn in an illegitimate child of the royal family who was deceived. With his past powers, Simon again creates his legend in this land. Surely, it must be a revenge and reconquer road filled with blood!

(Source: Mangatoon)

114597.description:
Tasuku Kashiwagi and Kyu Imamiya are public servants, working for the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry. Imamiya thinks his reliable junior should hurry up and get himself some new friends and a lover already - but Kashiwagi just insists on doting over him...almost like some loving wife.

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

114598.description: Out of the blue, the new president, Taiga, suddenly ordered Amami Kei to become his secretary. Though confused, Kei reluctantly agree but upon meeting Taiga, Kei was shocked to see the person who was responsible for his trauma way back from high school! Kei immediately rejected Taiga’s proposal but Taiga couldn’t take the rejection well. And so starts the love pursuit relentlessly!

114599.description:
What if an unexpected accident suddenly transported you back to ten years ago? For Hayoung, suddenly traveling back in time to high school means the opportunity to save the life of Jaehyun, the one person she's always loved... Will she be able to change both of their fates?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 緋牡丹のジュリエット

114603.description:
The dreamer boy, Taiyo, looks up to the COOL and WAVY dancer, Kunishige Takato! a.k.a. God! When he moved to the capital, he used this chance to join the same dance studio as Takato. The real side of the cold-looking Takato is actually very frank? Moreover, he misunderstood Taiyo's gesture and went for a kiss..!?

Check out this tension-raising love comedy written by Haida Nanako!

(Source: Yaoi Sekai)

114605.description:
After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

(Source: Tapas)

"Can't... keep my... voice down." Nii-chan thrusting in me again and again. We shouldn't be doing this as siblings... so, why does it feel this good...?

114609.description:
Why has Lelouch become C.C.’s tutor?!

Lelouch and Nunnally were living in peace, but then one day a spoiled rich girl with absolutely no common sense named C.C. moved in next door. At the request of his mother, Marianne, Lelouch has taken on the task of ensuring her education – and now he’s made a contract with C.C. to be her personal tutor…?!

A high school AU comedy begins!

114610.description:
That wasn't nearly enough... Let's do it again.

Chinatsu, an office employee, finds herself forced into an arrangement by her parents where she has to live with a potential marriage partner. He seems kind of moody, but whenever he lets slip a smile, Chinatsu feels her heart skip a beat. He's kind and perfectly attentive, too... So, maybe he's not so bad? Is how she feels until night comes around, and he completely changes! "What? You've never bathed with a man before?" He teasingly whispers into her ear, his fingers reaching ever closer to her most sensitive spot. Slipping his fingers inside her, she can't take any more and finds release...! If this happens every night, there's no way her body will last... And yet the next day, he's introduced at her office as a new manager! Any chance he gets, he embraces her, telling her how badly he wants her... How is she supposed to resist that!? Whether it's at home or the office, there's no end to this peerless man's desire!!

(Source: Renta!)

Despite all the knowledge and expertise he’s devoted to his adventuring party, his respected leader kicked him out, his girlfriend dumped him, and his teammates shamelessly accused him of embezzlement. Tired, heartbroken, and looking for a drink, Nick chances upon a few kindred spirits who are jaded as he is. Together, these disillusioned adventurers form an unstoppable team out to save their bleak, depressing world!

(Source: Yen Press)

114629.description:
"The coastal town in which I live, has everything but also nothing."

Sakura is a 2nd year high school student who lives an ordinary life. She believes high school life should be much more free, gorgeous, and filled with sparkles every day. But in reality, it's not like that at all... That's when Ao-kun, who is one year her junior, appears before her. Since meeting Ao, Sakura's ordinary days are now filled with sparkles. This is a sweet, youthful love story between a super positive boy and super negative girl!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Included One-shot: Ai Aru Kimi to, Koisuru Usotsuki. (愛ある君と、恋する嘘つき。)
synonyms: Ai Aru Kimi to, Koisuru Usotsuki.

114630.description: A droid picked up an abandoned child and decided to raise it.

title.native: あるドロイドのおはなし

114631.description:
A pure love comedy between a French Otaku Girl and a mysterious Ikemen! When she was still in France, Natalie went through a heartbreak that made her want to end her life. Surprisingly, the ray of hope that saved her from despair was that "Mysterious Man" from the country of anime and manga! Now determined to live her life to the fullest, she went straight to Japan to become closer to her 2D love!

(Source: MANGA.CLUB)
114631.hashtag: #ナタリーとひみつのタクミくん

title.native: ナタリーとひみつのタクミくん

114632.description:
Hikari loves her classmate Maho, who she's known since they were little. They display their affection for each other so much it draws the suspicions of everyone. But, this is all a show as Maho is actually involved with another girl... After school, classmate Ai asks Hikari, "Is it really okay if your girlfriend is flirting with another girl?" Without knowing what Ai's game is, Hikari finds herself being kissed by her... and seduced. Ai does things to her that she's always wanted to do with Maho. Despite the heartbreak, she's physically enraptured... A feeling of loss quickly takes a turn in this tale of schoolgirl discovery.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Patterns of Yuri at the Girls' School

114633.description:
Kyo and Nanase are a couple who have been married for three years.
They are on the verge of divorce because of a single pudding!
Is marriage just the beginning of divorce?
A battle of wills begins between husband and wife!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

114634.description:
Due to the nature of her father's job, Hinoka has transferred schools several times. When her friends from her first school ceased contact after her transfer, Hinoka resolved never to become close to anyone again. Now in her seventh transfer school, she joins the idle astronomy club, thinking she could continue living her life alone. But what happens when she meets a boy who shines like the brightest star, Sirius, on a cloudy day?

Included one-shots: Bousou Otome★Muu, Suppinpin!

114635.description: MC is revived with no memories, however, she knows that she was trying to find someone that was dear to her. With the help of a detective, she has 49 days to find out who revived her.

114636.description:
Anzusa married Takafumi Kisaragi, the eldest son of a prominent family in the countryside. It was supposed to be a happy marriage with a kind man, but her mother-in-law's attitude towards her changes for the worse when they still don't have any children after three years…!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 長男の妻～玉の輿には裏がある～
title.romaji: Chounan no Tsuma: Tamanokoshi ni wa Ura ga Aru

title.native: アラフォー戦隊ラブチアーズ

114638.description:
I, Teruaki Nakamura, transferred to a school in Okinawa and developed a crush on a girl named Kiyan-san, but I don't understand her dialect. Higa-san is always helping me by translating the dialect. A slightly different cultural love starts on the southern island.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

title.native: 沖縄で好きになった子が方言すぎてツラすぎる
title.romaji: Okinawa de Suki ni Natta Ko ga Hougen Sugite Tsura Sugiru

114639.description:
The food gag manga follows an editor named Hoshino and her fiancee Kouhei as they live their normal everyday lives, and centers on the topic of "what would you eat for your final meal?"

(Source: Anime News Network)

114640.description:
When Pete's late father leaves him a map of treasure island, the young boy roars down to the dock and hops on a ship headed for adventure. With his friends, the ship's captain and his trusty canine companion, by his side, Pete must face off against the scourge of the seven seas, the dread pirate boar! But when a sudden storm sends everyone into the sea, the race is on to see who will claim the riches of treasure island first... With only man-eating sharks, an island-full of hungry cannibals, and a small army of lions, tigers and elephants, all under the control of an enigmatic Tarzan-like figure named baron, standing in their way.

(Source: Digital Manga Guild)

Note: The original version of "New Treasure Island" was based on Tezuka Osamu's manuscript, but substantial modifications were made by Sasaki Shichima, who cut nearly 60 pages and also changed some of the lines. When publishing "The Complete Works of Tezuka Osamu," Tezuka Osamu remade it based on his memory to make it closer to his original. That's the version this entry encompasses.

114641.description: An abused girl, Miyazaki, tries to find the meaning to her life through her teacher and her boyfriend.

114642.description:
The setting is the near future, where cyborg technology to remodel living human beings has developed. Cyborged humans gained strength, and gangs that use their power to grow their organization are dominating some cities. One day, a cyborg girl named Mako comes to Row, a man who works for a living cyborg agency in the city, and asks, "can you interview me?". However, cyborg children are outlawed. The friendly Row decides to hire her, even though he knows she was in a former gang. The action comedy series begins.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

114643.description:
One day, an office worker who works at an exploitive company finds a girl he doesn't know in his room after returning home on the last train. The man's uninvited visitor turns out to be a god of poverty.

Included one-shot:
Volume 7: Binbin Fukufuku Nazuna-sama! (Pilot)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

114644.description:
100 years have passed since alphas and omegas went extinct... Now, they can only be read about in the pages of school textbooks. In a world full of betas, Yutaro Ayase, a rare omega, was born. He spends his days acting in guy-on-guy adult movies in order to pay for the expensive suppressants he secretly takes. Convinced that he'll never be able to fall in love like everyone else, he one day meets Ryo Inukai, a man who could be his destiny. Unsure of why's he's so attracted to Ryo, Yutaro finds himself thirsting for the executive director. Just when they're about to make love for the first time, though, something happens! Is this feeling love, or just basic instinct...?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Jinrui Saigo no Alpha to Omega

title.native: ラスト・オメガバース

114645.description:
Pessimistic high school student Hana Tabata doesn't believe her life could ever be like that of a heroine from the shoujo manga she reads—she's convinced she's ugly, and she's always alone. Still, she can't help but imagine herself as a leading lady when she's changing out flowers early one morning...until she's caught in the act by her handsome classmate Yousuke Ueno! Hana can't wrap her head around his kind words at first, but as they grow closer, she finds her life slowly beginning to change…

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes the sequel "Busu ni Hanataba wo. Bloom (ブスに花束を。~Bloom~)".
synonyms: A Bouquet for an Ugly Girl
April showers bring forth May flowers

114646.description:
Kuromi Girls’ Academy is a refined, elegant school that expects the very best in deportment from its young ladies. Aya got into this peerless rich-girls’ institution on a scholarship, and hopes to grow as lovely as her fellow student and idol Shirayui. But Shirayui hides a terrible secret: she’s a trash-talking, combo-chaining, newbie-stomping, ruthless hardcore gamer! Could a mutual indulgence in no-holds-barred video game combat grow into a deeper rapport between these two girls?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

114647.description:
Kyosuke never thought that he'd ever be content with just one person, but now that he has Fujishima in his heart and on his bed, suddenly everything is different. From soft kisses to sharing spare keys, every first between the newly-minted lovers is uncharted territory, but with both their busy schedules it's been hard to get some time just to themselves. Is this the biggest of their problems, however, when Kyosuke gets a threatening letter in the mail?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Bitch na Neko wa Dokusenyoku ni Aragaenai

114648.description:
Mr. Shinzou Hiruma, playwright, actor, and spokesman of the theatre troupe "Hydra" expresses interest in the up-and-coming actor KYO. But there's a problem - Kyosuke has no repertory theatre experience, and especially not in the stage combat scenes Hydra is well-known for! Can Kyosuke successfully juggle his intense training and make time for his non-celebrity boyfriend Fujishima, or will his admiration for "Mr. Shin" drive a wedge in their relationship for good?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114650.description: Jang Jiheon, a businessman, falls in love at first sight with Geon during a snooker game. Jiheon's unbearable desires forces Gon to spend a night with him. 114658.description:
​Naoko Tsuji, an unorthodox health teacher at an all-girls school, doubts whether the sex ed status quo truly teaches young people everything they need to know—so she ramps it up to 120%! Luckily for Tsuji, her class proves to be an almost unflappable group, including a BL fan, a lesbian, and a girl who just really likes her cat! With topics like safe sex for same-gender couples, masturbation positivity, and why sugar gliders have three vaginas, this sex education comedy is more than just dirty jokes. It’s time for class!

(Source: Yen Press)

114660.description: Mikoko works Hyogo City's taxation office. But instead of appearing calm in front of a client, her behaviour can lead to many unpredictable actions. Because of that, she is moved to a different work team and is now in a team with a frivolous male civil servant, Kenichiro Sakichiro. Follow their daily routine!

114661.description:
This is a manga about a high school health and physical education teacher, Professor Tsuji, who enjoys bright and fun sex education.

(Source: Author, translated)

114662.description:
Saki-chan, a succubus, has fallen in love with Rokuhara, a son of the temple, of all people. She tries her best to talk to him, but her succubus blood runs wild and she always ends up tempting him. "I wish I could say I love you honestly!"

This is a story about a pure and simple love of a succubus who can't be honest.

title.native: 咲ちゃんは淫魔の子（合掌）

114663.description: Chieri fell asleep on the veranda outside her classroom and accidentally witnessed a breakup between Ando-kun, the most handome boy in school, and their English teacher. When she tries to confront Ando-kun about the forbidden relationship, he turns around and threatens to make Chieri a social outcast by pretending to kiss her!

title.native: 戀をするならキミ以外
title.romaji: Koi wo Suru nara Kimi Igai

114664.description:
In the Saiga family, cursed blood flows through the veins of the Saiga males. For a few, this blood grants them powers, but it also taxes the body heavily. The only way to appease the hunger is via body fluids.

Akio Saiga’s curse bestowed upon him the ability to read people’s minds. At long last he has found his “other half,” Miyuu, and has taken her as his wife. While the curse still has its hold on Akio, he senses something else when he’s with Miyuu…a place he’s never been to…and a girl he’s never met…or has he?
synonyms: Kuro Ookami no Ichizoku: Meguriau Kemono no Kougou
黒狼の一族　～巡り合う獣の交合～

114665.description:
This year's third issue of Akita Shoten's Young Champion magazine revealed on Tuesday that Takashi Noguchi will launch a new manga series in the next issue on January 26. The series is titled Koudou Wolf (Highway Wolf), and it will feature highway races. The manga's first chapter will be 45 pages long and include color opening pages.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114666.description:
As a socially awkward college student, Hayeon lives a pretty boring life -- except she can communicate with outer space. One day, she meets Ujun, an alien who is curious about human nature. When she rejects his request to “borrow” her body, he takes over the body of her crush! As Hayeon helps Ujun adjust to human life, their friendship blossoms into something more. However, their love story faces many obstacles, including an alien plotting to invade Earth. What will be the fate of these star-crossed lovers?

(Source: WEBTOON)

114667.description:
Nezu was looking forward to his elementary school reunion—after all, his class was united by unbreakable bonds. But when his former classmate, Mikio, reveals that this reunion is a very real matter of life and death...suddenly Nezu finds those bonds put to the test.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: We Who Are Shadows of Our Former Selves
จุดจบแห่งเงามืดครั้งอดีต

title.english: The Shadows of Who We Once Were

114669.description:
Azami Takefuji is forced out of her job due to her abuse of power. This leads her to attend her high school reunion for the first time in a long time. In high school, she was like the queen of her class, and her classmates followed her orders obediently. When Azami turns up without any notice, her classmates warmly welcome her at first. However, she also has a dark past from her high school days, and Azami is blamed for this at the reunion. In fact, she was not the "queen" at all, but "public enemy number one" instead... Azami wishes she could go back to the past and atone for the sins she committed… A time-leap role-reversal suspense story!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

114670.description: A spin-off of Mitsudomoe, this series is comprised of single-page chapters that could not be published along with the original manga.

114671.description:
Panic disorder, depression, developmental disorders, and more. Japan, often called a hidden mental illness superpower, actually has fewer mental health patients compared to countries like the United States. On the other hand, its suicide rate is among the worst in developed nations. Even when people are struggling, the perception that psychiatric care is something special keeps them from seeking help. Psychiatrist Yowai hopes to change this reality in Japan and save as many hearts as possible. Actually, he sincerely hopes that the number of mental health patients in his country will increase.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

114672.description:
Six one-shots, including Nightow's doujin work before his debut.

1) Sandy to Tooi Mori no Nakamatachi
2) Bokura no Zujou ni Kare no Basho
3) Christmas Heart
4) Call xxxx
5) Christmas Heart Again
Extra: Satellite Lovers
synonyms: Little SANDY with Monsters in the Megaforest

114675.description:
Everyone must believe their love is real; everyone but themselves... Maggie, code name Chameleon, is a master of disguise and works for a Secret Service branch called Omega. She solves cases by taking up different personas, and this time her mission is to serve as a body double for the vice president. Omega's director, Adam, will be going on the mission with Maggie, posing as her lover. His role will allow him to stay close to her. He promises to always be by Maggie's side, which is going to be tough for her because she's had hidden feelings for the calm and elegant Adam for a very long time.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

114676.description:
Ron Ron, the baby panda, was born with a crying voice exactly like a human. When he turned 6, he suddenly can talk like in human language, thus claiming for his own human rights. When the world granted his wish, Ron Ron was then adopted to Sasahito family. He might be a 6-years-old panda, but his soul is a 15-years-old male in puberty! This little pervert panda who deceives everyone with his cute face, what kind of extraordinary life will he experience in the neighborhood?

(Source: Manga.Club)

114677.description:
The Oracle Princess Alfina suddenly announces an ominous prophecy to the people of the Kingdom of Crownheight. However, shunned as she is for being a descendant of rebel blood, her words are heeded by no one. On the other hand, Ricardo, the adopted heir of a peddler, who also happens to be an economics department graduate reincarnated into this world, attends the Royal Academy to study as a merchant. During an argument with a much more affluent merchant, the one to stick up for him is none other than Alfina. As the distance between them rapidly closes, Ricardo makes full use of his modern knowledge of science, mathematics and economics to stand against the unknown disaster of prophecy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

114680.description:
This is a story about Mari, a modest and inconspicuous girl who dreams of becoming a manga artist. Born into a complicated family, she lives a modest school life while hanging onto her dream. One day, after saving Shigeru Hanamizuki, the most popular boy in class, from a traffic accident, he confesses to her. However, Mari turns him down because of certain circumstances...

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

114681.description: Hiromi Harashima, Yotsuba Bank clerk, age 30, height 173 cm. She believes that banks must invest in business and human potential. With this in mind she strives, gracefully, unhurriedly and at her own pace, to become the ideal banker.

114684.description:
Azusa is the proud owner of her very own flower shop. One day, she goes to a company to deliver a plant, and she meets the president, Naoya, who happens to be incredibly handsome and sweet, even though he's a bit of a tease. Naoya is so calm and gentle with her despite how awkward she can be around guys. Azusa can't help but be attracted to him. She assumes she's never going to see him again, but not too long after, she realizes she couldn't have been more wrong... He's going to be her new stepbrother! One thing leads to another, and they end up agreeing to live together, too!! A love story between an awkward girl who's shy around men and her reliable chivalrous stepbrother who's a total hottie.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 社長が義兄（あに）になりまして

title.english: The Company President Is My New Stepbrother
title.native: 社長が義兄になりまして

114685.description:
This boy looks so cool, so it can't be helped if I fall in love. "We've been so close ever since middle school, so now, I can't tell him I like him..." is what Akemiya feels with an unrequited love towards Iwata. But upon entering high school and becoming friends with the two popular hotties, Fujiwara and Shirotaki, Iwata is starting to get cocky!!

Iwata and Akemiya, the super popular side characters of "Fujiwara-kun wa Daitai Tadashii" presents the long-awaited super popular spinoff series that will make your chest squeeze, give you warm fuzzies, make you laugh and make you cry ♪.
synonyms: Don't get carried away, for Iwata!
Iwata no Kuse ni Choushi ni Noruna!
不就是岩田君吗？别太嚣张！

114686.description: A world where demons prevail and humans are rare. Hiyori, a human, is considered to be delicious to demons. However, his classmate, Hodaka, a pushy big-horned demon, found out his secret. On top of that, he kissed and tasted him…Charming a demon---a troublesome situation?! Surrendering to one's instinct and pleasure leads to…

114690.description:
"This is the real me." -- Having no defined sense of self, Suzuno spends each day simply trying her best to be the ideal woman. She somehow manages to impersonate a very capable woman at the stationery company where she works. One day, though, her handsome, prince-like coworker, Watarai, finds out what she's really like! Once they are alone together, Suzuno realizes that Watarai, himself, is not actually the princely type he seems to be... What's more, Watarai finds out that Suzuno is shouldering her parents' debt. The morning after Suzuno reveals all to the office prince, she wakes up in her own bed... To none other than a naked Watarai sleeping beside her?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Look at Me, and Me Alone

114692.description:
"Well then, how much will you pay to have me?" - Office worker Sumika has lived in perpetual mourning since losing Haruki, her first love who once lifted her out of the grief of losing her only family. A friend from work drags her out to a party, and there she meets Mr. Katsuragi, the vice president of the company hosting the party. It ought to be their first time meeting... and yet, he gives off the impression of already knowing Sumika very well. On top of that, just when Sumika is at her wits' end trying to think of a way to save the family that took her in, Mr. Katsuragi offers to buy her hand in marriage...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Condolences, but Starting Today You're My Wife
title.native: お気の毒さま、今日から君は俺の妻
title.romaji: Okinodoku-sama, Kyou kara Kimi wa Ore no Tsuma

title.native: クールな御曹司と極甘同居
title.romaji: Cool na Onzoushi to Gokuama Doukyo

114694.description:
The manga centers on Kahori Mirumachi, a lawyer who only gets into shallow relationships, saying that she only wants to "indulge in the delicious parts of a relationship," her only rule being to not become a part of an affair. However, despite her best efforts, she ends up falling in love with the teacher Teruyoshi Sunagoya, unaware that he is going through divorce proceedings, and thus she unwittingly gets into an affair with him.

(Source: Anime News Network)

114695.description:
Azusa is a manga artist who debuted in the shoujo manga magazine "Cinnamon." However, now that she's 22 years old her publications are in a dangerous state. She's never had any experience in love before, but she wonders if she had loved before, would she be able to write heart-throbbing manga...!?

(Source: ShoujoHearts)

Included one-shot: Blue Friend: Nijiiro no Kanojo (ブルーフレンド～虹色の彼女～)

114696.description:
I'm Haru. first year in high school. Please listen to my troubles. I accidentally gave my love letter to the number one problem child at school, Seishirou-lun...

Even though I told him to give it back, he won't. He says I'm already his girlfriend...He'll chase me down if he sees me at school, he takes my lunch, keeps his eye on me, and e-even kisses me...Ah and doing perverted stuff...!!

And he's also living at my place.... I'm definitely not his girlfriend, so please let me go already!!!

title.native: なめて、かじって、ときどき愛でて

114697.description:
Asami works at her dream job as a wedding dress designer for an apparel company. But her life is completely turned on its head when her father, a company investor, sets up an arranged marriage interview for her and Takafumi, her company's CEO! Despite Takafumi's professional competence and good looks, Asami bluntly rejects the offer, refusing to have to tie the knot with such an incredibly brazen and rude man. Despite this, Takafumi, realizing he gets turned on by her rejection, devises a plan which ultimately forces Asami into marriage and moving in with him! Is this the beginning of a sweet married life between Asami and her annoying boss?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm Being Married Off to the CEO?!
title.native: クールなCEOと社内政略結婚!?

114700.description:
Hazuki is a secretary in the cardiothoracic surgery department and she has had enough with handsome men. They've only broken her heart! That's why she has to keep turning down the extremely good-looking Dr. Kagami, even though he is absolutely relentless in his pursuit. title.native: ラパス・テーマパーク
木崎少年のほろにが喫茶巡礼
title.romaji: Kizaki Shounen no Horoniga Kissa Junrei

114803.description: Spin-off of Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio following Takao, I-402, and Zuikaku in a "SF road movie comedy" taking place while the trio are infiltrating Yokosuka.

114805.description:
Honor student Maruka Suzuki hides a dark secret and a death wish. She knows the world is full of monsters disguised as adults, and she’s recklessly looking for a creature to turn her to mush. When one such “Groan-Up” saves her instead, she sees this rabbitlike being named Mochizuki not as her executioner…but as some serious relationship material! Girlfriend and boyfriend, human and monster, wielder and weapon—how far will Maruka and Mochizuki go, and what other mysteries lie in store for them?

(Source: Yen Press)

114806.description: The comedy manga centers on heavy cruiser Takao. After losing her first battle with I-401, Takao secretly infiltrates Hakodate to observe the lives of various humans.

114808.description:
Tondemo Janitor x Angel Face Student President

The student council president, Kiyoto, goes to school after school to look for ghostly rumors of going out to the old school building.
There he meets Ayashii's long-haired man Shichirou, a janitor and son of a director.
The ghost of the rumor was a prank that Shichirou set up to "revive the seven wonders in the school" ...!
Kiyoto was trying to stop the mischief, but he was inadvertently helping Shichiro! Occult BL!

114810.description:
The 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis was a declaration of war on the Longinus Dreizehn Orden!

The Longinus Dreizehn Orden stood in the way of the allied forces during World War II and left them with a sense of defeat, after which they disappeared without a trace…

But a certain man’s testimony revealed the existence of this group to the world. The major powers of the world, considering them a serious threat, awaken a witch. One created in secrecy.

In the spotlight, the Longinus Dreizehn Orden’s own witch, Rusalka Schwägelin, enters the stage. The battle between witches hurls the stage that is America into a chaotic tempest that defies human knowledge.

The truth about the 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis is revealed at last!

title.romaji: Dies irae: Song to the Witch

114812.description:
Stress, sighs and wool felt. That was the daily life of Hayashi, a serious and timid office worker. However, one day, he met the passionate Tamaki through a hole she made in the wall of his apartment. Will the hole they share lead to the future he envisioned as a kid?

(Source: Amazon.jp, adapted)

title.native: 君と僕のホールシェア
title.romaji: Kimi to Boku no Hole Share

114813.description:
On the night of the Star Festival, an event to celebrate the founding of the proud, illustrious Kingdom of Heilland, Queen Alicia was stabbed through the chest and killed by revolutionary soldiers storming the castle… Or so she thought. Princess Alicia wakes on the morning of her 10th birthday, memories of the “Night of the Revolution” fresh in her mind, and realizes that she has been given a chance to redo her life. It’s not long before she comes face to face with the handsome and mysterious young man who killed her last time… Granted a chance at redemption by the whims of fate, Alicia works to change the disastrous future, this time with revolutionary mastermind turned princess aide Clovis by her side!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Redemption of the Blue Rose Princess

董白伝~魔王令嬢から始める三国志~

114821.description:
In the summer of his third-year of high school, 18-year-old Takae Reika was struggling with preparations for his university entrance exams when he ran into a beautiful 38-year-old woman Misa-san. Reika fell in love at first sight with Misa, who had just had broken up with her boyfriend, and he pretended to be his 25-year old brother to hide their true age difference. But he did not know that Misa-san also had a secret of her own.... A love comedy featuring a 20-year age difference, between an 18-year old high school boy and a 38-year old unmarried woman, that all started with a lie!

Includes an omake.

title.native: じごくらく 〜最強の抜け忍 がまんの画眉丸〜
title.romaji: Jigokuraku: Saikyou no Nuke Shinobu Gaman no ga Mayu Maru

114824.description:
The stoic golfer girl Tsukikage Kagari meets the upbeat transfer student Hinata Mawari at a golf course! Watch as their fun and relaxing golf diary unfolds!

(Source: Cyan Steam)

114825.description: Note: Chapter count includes 24 regular chapters and 3 extras.

title.native: 底辺チューバーが宇宙戦争を撮ってみた
title.romaji: Teihen-Tuber ga Uchuu Sensou wo Totte Mita

114826.description:
It was August, and the "Blue Moon" had come around - a phenomenon wherein two full moons appear in the same month. As a seventeen-year-old, I found myself in Arashiyama, Kyoto, at my grandmother's house for a somber funeral. It was on this solemn occasion that a peculiar encounter awaited me. Under the radiant light of the first full moon, I stumbled upon a mysterious sight. There before me was a young girl, gracefully using an umbrella to scoop water from a spring, her actions illuminated by the moon's ethereal glow. She said, "I'll be here until the Blue Moon ends," and despite our same ages, she had a mysterious aura about her, as if hiding a great secret. That secret was that “I've been waiting for you in the future." This is a love story stretching across time and space, depicting two people bound by fate.

(Source: Regin's Chronicles)

title.english: Love under the Blue Moon: Falling in Love again
title.native: 青い月の夜、もう一度彼女に恋をする
title.romaji: Aoi Tsuki no Yoru, Mou Ichido Kanojo ni Koi wo Suru

114828.description:
After an asteroid destroys Earth, Moon You unintentionally becomes the last person in existence, or so he thinks. Stuck on a research facility on the moon, he struggles with being the last person alive. Little does he know that humankind is watching his every move from Earth.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

114829.description:
Placed on the back of the neck, iMood can easily control emotions by pressing it lightly. In the short period of 20 years after iMood was born, the society seems to be in harmony, but the hidden crisis is the collapse of human emotions. Yu Qing Le is a police officer who also has an iMood addiction. The overture of a serial killer started from a dead woman nailed to the ceiling...

(Source: WebComics)

114830.description:
Inui Narumi is an entry-level office worker who is put under the supervision of Director Shishidou, a stunning woman with a fearsome reputation in the company as a merciless boss. Inui begins recognizing that Shishidou is indeed a merciless and ambitious boss where it's warranted, but this doesn't mean that she's not doting or kind, or that she doesn't take care of her employees, and better yet... she starts to bring him with her wherever she goes!

Still, does she realize just how kind she is towards him? Is she proceeding out of duty to her subordinate, or is there something special about Inui in particular?

title.native: 獅子堂さんに叱られたい

114831.description:
I'm an orphan who only ever dreamt of cooking until I fell into the clutches of the Zhao Manor. Due to my perfect looks, I found myself in constant peril, but as fate would have it, this top assassin kidnappe— I mean, employed me to be his personal chef! When he first brought me to his lair, I thought, "What the heck am I doughing here?" But he's a fierce fighter who protects me from danger, and I, Willow Ye, am determined to become a master chef! We make a great pear~ You butter believe it!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 bonus chapter.
synonyms: La diosa de la cocina y el asesino

114832.description:
A story full of mean girls and violence. A young boy trying to rise above his surroundings, and a rich girl trying to stay on top. Will the Queen be able to keep her throne?

(Source: DAYcomics)

114833.description:
The most popular person on campus, a pretty face with smiling eyes, a friendly-yet-awkward classmate…that’s all Sung-yeon ever was to Hosik. But after a wild night out, Hosik awakes with zero memories of their time together - and one naked Sung-yeon in bed next to him! Hosik would have been fine with leaving their relationship as a drunken mistake on a night of many; but when he started feeling funny in the following days, a trip to the doctor’s office would change everything: “Mr. Kim Hosik, you’re pregnant!”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 37 extra chapters.
synonyms: ホシク物語〜男だけど妊娠しました〜

114834.description:
The two haven’t done anything yet—their true selves are naive, they are innocent, and they have never thought about something like falling in love, even in a dream. On that day, the delicate, young girl working in the bento shop meets... This is the story about a boy and a girl who, innocent and with no experience in romance, suddenly begins their lives as newlyweds.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

Note: The chapter count includes one extra chapter.

114836.description:
1 woman vs. 11 meat rods! Sultry, dense orgy!!!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Overwhelming calories!!! Behold a genius' maiden work!!

Monthly Shoujo Sunday is a collection of 12 oneshots by the wonderful Momoto Makiru. Known for their alternative and sometimes experimental art, Makiru brings us unique stories that are both weird and enlightening.

(Source: Star Fruit Books)

7) Fushigi na Sekai
8) Ayumi-chan

10) Sacchan wa ne!

114844.description: The second son of a draper store, Tenji is a beautiful boy that is earnest and kind as Bodhisattva. Tenji, who loves pretty things — especially hairpins — accidentally meets his favorite hairpin artisan, Shunsuke, one day, and ends up being shown around his workplace. Elated, he even follows Shunsuke to his home, but Shunsuke mistook Tenji for a woman and assaulted him! Shunsuke is actually a sensual man who welcomes all comers but never concerns himself with those who leave! And when he realizes Tenji is a man!? A beautifully and bewitchingly composed Edo picture scroll of passion of two straight men!
synonyms: Bidou Wakadanna Koi Shitau Wa Koushoku Otoko

title.native: 美童若旦那、恋慕ふは好色男
title.romaji: Bidou Wakadanna, Koi Shitau wa Koushoku Otoko

114845.description:
In the small country of Ciel-Terra, the Royal Prince staged a coup d’etat, killed his own brother, the former King and took control of the throne with the backing of the Four Great Kingdoms. On her 10th birthday, René was apprehended by the knights of the Royal Prince faction for being a cursed child with silver hair and silver eyes and learnt that she was the abandoned Princess of the country. And so, branded as one who ‘was related to the depraved once-king’, she was put through hellish torture before being executed via guillotine.

As her head parted from her body, René remembered. That, she once already lived life as a man by the name of Nagajiro Satou on Earth, and, falling victim to this world’s God flattery, was forcibly reincarnated. Thus René, in the name of revenge, rose as the strongest and most fearsome undead. Named Monster: Rose Princess of Hellrage. And eventually, she will end the world…

title.native: 怨獄の薔薇姫 政治の都合で殺されましたが最強のアンデッドとして蘇りました
title.romaji: Engoku no Bara Hime Seiji no Tsugou de Korosaremashita ga Saikyou no Undead Toshite Yomigaerimashita

114846.description:
The protagonist is the second son of the Yanagiya Restaurant, Short tempered and has had a lot of problems with the police. He trained himself in the art of flavor through working at street stalls. His creative way of cooking gives a glimpse of his true potential.

However after learning the difference between an amateur and professional in his battle against his older brother who has taken over the family business, he has left on a journey to train...
The 18 year old hooligan of a chef Musashi, from Mito. takes to the front lines, going to the extreme to create a flavor that captures the hearts and tongues of everyone who tastes it!!

(Source: MANGA.CLUB)

114847.description:
In the real world, Taehyun Kim has a boring low-effort life, but as a virtual reality gamer, he lives for a harsh challenge. Why become the best player in the world’s hottest online game if you’re going to do it the easy way? Warrior? Nope. Rogue? Nah. Taehyun wants to reach #1 as a blacksmith or, even better yet, unemployed. Unfortunately for him, his natural skills keep interfering, and this game likes him way too much! Seriously, how the hell did he end up as the god of luck?!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ผมคือเพลเยอร์ผู้มากับโชค

114848.description: "GIRO" features a collection of imaginative comics by underground artist, Jiro Ishikawa from 1996-2001, published by TACO ché in Tokyo.

114849.description:
28-year-old Suzutaro who can't do housework at all, loves being spoiled! and Santa, (who spoils Suzutaro,) is a 32-year-old with a gentle beard who handles all household chores. A fun, sometimes a little salty, but very happy, series of shorts that show casual everyday life is lovely ☆

(source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

114850.description: Sakagami is nearing graduation and spending less time at his part-time job with Kaori. Will they realize their feelings for each other before they go their separate ways?
synonyms: 不想输给年下的先辈酱2

114854.description:
A tone-deaf boy named Shoddy has been kicked out of the Children's Choir. Yet, in a strange turn of events, he gets taken in by Mister Demon, who becomes his vocal coach. There's just one problem... Shoddy's songs are meant to kill demons! But despite this unlikely duo, their innocent laughter can still be heard every night from the ruins of an abandoned church.

(Source: MANGA UP!)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: คุณปิศาจกับเพลงของผม

114856.description: Utsunomiya has been a single virgin until all the way to his 30th birthday. Then one night on his way home from work, something happened that caused a shift in time which made him go back to the past during his days in high school. There, he meets his teacher Shitara-sensei again and somehow they end up living together!?
synonyms: 水性杨花的老师总是浑身湿透

title.native: ふしだら先生はいつも濡れ衣

114858.description:
Akiko Nishio works overtime every day at the office and only has two things to look forward to in her life. The first one is the cute banter during her busy day that she has with her younger co-worker, Shinnosuke Onda, who tells her he's gonna be super sweet on her for all her hard work to cheer her on. The second is the escort service she uses on the weekends to reward herself. Then, one day, after booking a popular new guy, Kaito, Akiko gets really drunk to calm her nerves. When she meets Kaito, he teases her a lot more than she expected and they end up in a motel on their first date!? Even though Akiko knows this is wrong, when he rubs his tongue all over her sensitive area... and asks her what she wants him to do, her body gets very aroused...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Shinnosuke Is Great At Comforting Me -My Co-worker Has His Way With Me Day And Night-

114859.description:
Iori has trouble dating men. She can't stand men's kissing face, so she ends up breaking up before the relationship goes any further. One day, her senior from work takes her to a bar where she is reunited with "Mana," a childhood friend. She hugs her saying "I wanted to see you so much," but the way she touches her is weird. Mana actually has a secret...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.romaji: Naze ka Hentai-kun ni Dekiai sareteimasu

114860.description:
The story is Shizuka’s awakening to life as a vampire, while she befriends classmates and fellow Epicureans, and tries to befriend Ichi-gou. Shizuka, on account of never feeding directly from a person is runty, and her bat wings are little, but with help she learns to find the idea of sucking Ichi-gou’s blood alluring.

(Source: Okazu)
synonyms: God of the Moon High School

114861.description:
By some ill fortune, Hikaru died in a traffic accident. He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he took an unexpected request to transfer his soul into a person in another world. He received an ability called Soul Board which he could use to allocate points to Skills to make himself more powerful. But there was a catch…

"I want you to take revenge on someone for me within an hour. If you don’t, I’ll destroy your soul."

To pull off the task assigned to him, he poured all his available points to the Stealth skill tree. This is a story of a boy who specialised in Stealth. With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivalled strength in another world.
synonyms: The Undetectable Strongest Job: Rule Breaker

title.native: 察知されない最強職（ルール・ブレイカー）

114864.description: Nana has lost all the crayons to her store along with Monkichi! Each chapter title is based on the game Shiritori and the theme of the chapter is based on the title which helps Nana find her crayons and Monkichi.

114865.description:
Bake youkai, fry youkai, boil youkai, saute youkai. And eat them... The beginning of the youkai gastronomy story.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

114866.description:
His first impression was the worst.
Nariyuki Kishibe, the best friend of Mamoru's uncle and childhood friend of his aunt, is an unlikable guy who's always frivolous and says random things. Mamoru, who starts to live at his uncle's house since he got into college, is fed up with Nariyuki, who gets worse every time he sees him. However, his heart races when Nariyuki occasionally shows his cool, mature side. One day, Mamoru ends up sleeping over at Nariyuki's place, but why is he getting aroused while they're in bed together!? Nariyuki wakes up and kisses Mamoru, and then they end up taking the next step!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 僕は僕の書いた小説を知らない
title.romaji: Boku wa Boku no Kaita Shousetsu wo Shiranai

114869.description:
The novel's story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

(Source: Anime Newss Network)

title.native: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
title.romaji: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e

114870.description:
A young man named Kazuma insists on becoming a student of one Mamiya Tojirou, a renowned sword master. Though his true goal is revenge, he becomes enthralled by Mamiya's beautiful swordsmanship as well as the loneliness peeking from beneath the stern veneer. Meanwhile, Mamiya can't help but be charmed by Kazuma's youthful naivete even though he knows of his intentions.

Soon the two men are drawn together by their irresistible passion for each other. However, the revenge match is imminent...

114871.description:
After dying of overwork in Japan, Dahlia is reborn into a world filled with magic. Raised by a master of magical toolmaking, she develops a passion for the craft and becomes engaged to her father’s apprentice. Before her father can see her wed, however, he suddenly passes away. As if this weren’t enough, on the day before their wedding, her fiancé announces that he’s in love—but not with her! Dahlia finally realizes she needs to live for herself. She vows to be her own woman from now on and devote herself to her craft, even if it’s not quite the quiet life she was hoping for! From a chance encounter with a knight to starting her own company, there are challenges aplenty on the horizon. But this young craftswoman is no longer a shrinking violet—she’s Dahlia, and she’s ready to bloom.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Magical Device Craftsman Dahlia Won’t Hang Her Head Down Anymore

title.english: Dahlia in Bloom: Crafting a Fresh Start with Magical Tools
title.native: 魔導具師ダリヤはうつむかない ~今日から自由な職人ライフ~
title.romaji: Madougushi Dahlia wa Utsumukanai: Kyou kara Jiyuu na Shokunin Life

114872.description: Detective Ukishima has a kink: he gets sexually excited by dangerous situations. He has always jerked himself off after dangerous incidents, feeling both a sense of depravity and elation... but everything changes when he meets a suspicious man by the name of Makabe. On the day they meet, while still knowing nothing about each other, Ukishima is violently raped by Makabe, and derives an indescribable pleasure from it. However, when Makabe comes up as a suspect in the case that Ukishima is pursuing, their relationship becomes even more taboo…

114873.description:
In Fujino Village, young boys from the "Three Families" inherit the blood of a legend, the Snow Lady. They spend their days with the one who will become the sacrifice, Lady Harutsuge. Living in a village closed off from the outside world, they begin to unearth numerous secrets about their village and its rituals.

Note:
- An adaptation of the original CD drama series
- Includes the last five chapters, uncollected in the print release

114880.description: Spirits of those who've died a tragic death are unable to be led to the afterlife by the Black and White death gods. They wander aimlessly in the world of the living, unable to reincarnate. Two death gods go in search of the missing half, but will the person they find still be the person they were once familiar with?

114881.description: In the lonely center of a lonely, snow-laden forest lies a small cabin where two witches dwell. A meditation on their love, hatred, and loneliness.
synonyms: The Witches of the Forest of Solitude

114882.description:
No matter how much he thinks about that guy, his best friend already has his lover by his side.
In high school Yuito couldn’t let go of the unrequited love he kept under wraps.
Nevertheless, ten years later is this a destined reunion with that best friend, Shougo? However, when he finds out that Yuito has a sex friend, Shougo is filled with rage!! Why does he get angry, even though he also had a lover...?

Then he comes to the bewildered Yuito to confess: “I’ve always loved you”?!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

114884.description: An exemplary student with excellent grades, Souma was abandoned by his mother when he was a child and his aunt and uncle took him in. They are a wealthy family, but the uncle is completely uninterested in Souma, and his aunt loathes the fact that they have to take care of him. The only one who needs Souma in this unwelcoming household is his cousin Sakuya, who becomes very important to Souma. But 12 years later, when Sakuya learns about Souma’s plan to become independent, he takes Souma’s body by force…

114885.description:
Yukio is a normal salaryman who one day becomes relatives through marriage with his former classmate Hijiri. Now brother-in-laws in a sense, Yukio and Hijiri meet again spend time with each other. But, when they kiss during a drunken moment, they realize they might have a deeper relationship than just friends and brother-in-laws.

(Source: Futekiya)

114886.description:
When Fujita was in high school, she had but one romantic encounter - and it was with another girl. It happened one day when they ended up kissing. However, somewhere inside her, she knew a girl kissing another girl was wrong, so she chose to remain as just friends. Even when graduation came, she could not confess her feelings, and so the two girls split ways. Five years later, Fujita still thinks back to that romantic encounter. Meanwhile at work, due to one of her colleagues going on maternity leave, a new designer is brought into the company... and who does that designer turn out to be? None other than her high school crush!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

114889.description:
In the Omegaverse, Alphas and Omegas stand at the opposite ends of privilege, but the two can form a bond that no other can interfere with. Betas, the majority of the population, experience neither the prestige that alphas call, nor the treatment that omegas endure. Simon is one such Beta. As the aide to Maurice, the eldest born Alpha son of the prestigious Séchelles name, Simon must cater to Maurice's needs. And Maurice needs Simon. Determined to deter any Omega's attempt to entice him into a bond, Maurice is set on "bonding" with Simon, whom he looks up to and admires. However, will Maurice's duties, first and foremost as an Alpha, overtake his reasoning and human will?

(Source: Futekiya)

114892.description:
A maid’s victorian era dream romance twists into an NTR nightmare.

Alyssa’s a maid who's been recently hired to be the new help for a young aristocrat. During the day she helps with the simple cleaning of the mansion but by night, she helps her new master with his "sexual education training," so he can be a proper head of house. But as she’s gaining more favor him and slowly falls for his affections, the rest of the help in the manor plot to teach this maid her place.

Fanaticism by Siokonbu is a devious serving of dirty maids, torrid lessons, and a heaping portion of jealousy and NTR will satisfy readers’ eager eyes. Siokonbu’s artwork captures not only the elegant beauty of an innocent maid, but also the sadistic smile of her dominant mistress.

(Source: FAKKU!)

114897.description:
Kinu is a serious girl who studies hard. If she had a boyfriend, she would go on dates in the library. "All you have to do is study, I thought that kissing was only good after we were married." One day, however, she saw Haruka Mihara, who is rumored to be the most handsome guy in school, making out with a girl in the reference room. The shock of seeing it makes her legs go limp. The next day, she summons Mihara to an empty classroom and offers him a proposal...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)
synonyms: Game - Lust ohne Liebe in der Highschool

114898.description:
It’s a familiar story: a popular high school student gives their plain friend a makeover and transforms their life. But this time, the path to a new life isn’t quite so straight and narrow. Kenshirou Midou has loved cosmetics all his life, keeping his obsession secret from almost everyone except for his childhood friend Hiura Mihate. One day, Kenshirou gets permission to practice applying makeup on Hiura, and the results are earth-shattering: Hiura’s appearance transforms from a plain, undersized boy to a pretty, petite girl, and Kenshirou discovers just how freeing it is to apply his passion! Yet he’s not the only one who finds the process liberating. Hiura likes the makeup, and the subsequent “dress-up” in feminine clothes, and decides to start wearing the girls’ uniform to school. Kenshirou doesn’t understand if he’s unlocked something in Hiura, or if he’s simply seeing a new side to his childhood buddy that he never noticed before. What are these feelings bubbling between them now–is this attraction truly new?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

114899.description:
Gin is a tall private eye with a dangerous side project crafting potent drugs for mobsters. He's also an inept swordsman whose most powerful tool is... bluffing. Gin's about to get his butt handed to him when a short but deadly fighter named Ian rescues him with a ridiculously large weapon — just who is this shorty?! Despite Gin's best efforts to eject this annoying (albeit talented) kid from his life, danger knocks on their door. They've got big cases to solve and bigger secrets to discover.

(Source: Tapas)

Nite: Chapter count includes prologue.

114900.description:
A world where one country is split in half on the Berlin Wall.
East Germany.
Annabelle, who lives in a country dominated by socialism,
He had a secret love for a young book owner, Yukirou, who runs a used bookstore.
And the secret that the state's intrigue involves.
The times, the thoughts, the struggles are the walls that separate the two people.
An authentic historical play depicting people living in East Germany.
